tt36163614.description: Spanning five decades, Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition charts their iconic rise to become one of the biggest bands in music history.

tt41617470.name: Desire
tt41617470.description: Lucero lo tiene todo, pero un vacío la empuja al riesgo. Matías, el atractivo entrenador de natación, despierta en ella una obsesión: una relación que amenaza su mundo cuando su hija también se siente atraída por él.

tt39018643.name: Billie Eilish: Hit Me Hard and Soft
tt39018643.description: An accompanying 3D concert film, documenting the Manchester shows and co-directed by Eilish and James Cameron.

tt42373968.name: Gary
tt42373968.description: Two friends go on a work trip and encounter unexpected challenges and local personalities as they navigate their assignment. Their efforts to adapt to unfamiliar surroundings highlight moments of humor, small-town culture and the unpredictable nature of work travel. Their experience offers new perspectives on their friendship.

tt31390893.name: Raja Shivaji
tt31390893.description: The journey of the young Shivaji, who fought against the powers that be and was crowned as Chhatrapati monarch.

tt41877698.name: The Box in the Attic
tt41877698.description: After the death of her estranged mother, a troubled woman returns to her childhood home and discovers a box. When she breaks its seal, she unleashes malevolent entities tied to a dark family legacy and a deadly secret of her own.

tt29516222.name: Deep Water
tt29516222.description: A group of international passengers en route from Los Angeles to Shanghai are forced to make an emergency landing in shark-infested waters. Now they must work together in hopes to overcome the frenzy of sharks drawn to the wreckage.

tt36926359.name: Seven Snipers
tt36926359.description: A retired sniper in hiding on an Australian ranch must reunite her elite kill squad when a vengeful warlord threatens her daughter.

tt33058293.name: Riverkeeper
tt33058293.description: Veteran riverkeeper, Dr. Jackie Echols, protects the environment and majority Black communities throughout the South River watershed in metro Atlanta. When the city begins construction on the largest police training facility in America (Cop City), she joins the growing resistance movement, revealing the hidden connection between corporate development, unchecked pollution, and environmental racism persistent throughout the region.

tt41791573.name: Dear You
tt41791573.description: Xiaowei travels to Thailand to find his "billionaire grandfather" whom debt problems have kept out of contact, but he unexpectedly finds that the one who has been corresponding with his grandmother for years is not her husband.

tt31828554.name: Je M'appelle Agneta
tt31828554.description: Agneta, 49, is vibrant but seems invisible. Her kids have left home, her traffic office job is stuck, and she feels unseen. Meanwhile, her husband has found purpose through cold plunges and pricey cycling gear.

tt35674521.name: Rose of Nevada
tt35674521.description: Mysterious boat returns to a village 30 years after vanishing. Two men join its crew hoping for better fortune. After one voyage, they find themselves transported back in time, mistaken for the original crew.

tt13570066.name: Desert Warrior
tt13570066.description: An honorable and mysterious rogue, known as Hanzala, makes himself an enemy of the Emperor Kisra after he helps a fugitive king and princess in the desert.

tt27844906.name: Rosebush Pruning
tt27844906.description: A family struggling with genetic illnesses lives on a country estate. Personal drama develops amongst them in this intimate portrait.

tt25399154.name: Rose
tt25399154.description: In the early 17th century, a soldier arrives at an isolated Protestant village in Germany claiming to be the heir to an abandoned farmstead. Even though he proves to be a good man, the villagers’ suspicions about his identity grow and they force a reckoning.

tt34705112.name: Busboys
tt34705112.description: A pair of idiot friends believe that if they become waiters, all of their problems will be solved. They aren't entirely wrong, but they aren't entirely right.

tt33301434.name: Mile End Kicks
tt33301434.description: A 24-year-old music critic gets romantically involved with members of an indie band she decides to publicize.

tt18212138.name: Kill Code
tt18212138.description: In a crime plagued future, a power-hungry corporation has issued deadly watches to criminals, forcing them to eliminate each other for freedom, and only one of their own can topple the entire system from within.

tt27200708.name: Mother Mary
tt27200708.description: Long-buried wounds rise to the surface when iconic pop star Mother Mary reunites with her estranged best friend and former costume designer, Sam Anselm, on the eve of her comeback performance.

tt39314348.name: A Gorilla Story: Told by David Attenborough
tt39314348.description: David Attenborough tells the remarkable story of his first encounter with the baby gorilla Pablo, how that gorilla grew up to be a top Silverback and how Pablo's direct descendants are doing today.

tt40891145.description: When an unexpected road rage incident puts his son in critical condition, an enraged father spirals down a dark path of emotional turmoil and vengeance.

tt26735622.name: Balls Up
tt26735622.description: Two marketers pitch a bold new condom World Cup sponsorship. After a booze-fueled scandal, they must outrun chaos to survive.

tt32394984.name: Brothers Under Fire
tt32394984.description: Captain Jordan Wright's squadron on leave for a wedding in Mexico encounters a murderous cartel. As Jordan tries to lead survivors to safety, war erupts between his squad and the cartel, forcing him into a battle to save his men.

tt37540875.name: Roommates
tt37540875.description: When a hopeful, naive college freshman, Devon, asks the cool and confident Celeste to be her roommate, a blossoming friendship spirals into a war of passive aggression.

tt14619456.name: Faces of Death
tt14619456.description: Margot Romero, a content moderator haunted by a viral tragedy, must track down a sadistic filmmaker who recreates legendary snuff cinema to silence the internet's obsession with her own past trauma.

tt7708226.name: Beast
tt7708226.description: MMA legend Patton James, now a commercial fisherman, is pulled back into the cage when his brother is in danger. Reuniting with his old coach Sammy, he commits to one final fight in ONE Championship against its brutal champion Xav...

tt25868520.name: Tamerlane: Rise of the Last Conqueror
tt25868520.description: As the Mongol Empire crumbles, a battle-scarred Timur Barlas must confront a haunting destiny and renounce his loyalties to protect the fate of the Silk Road.

tt32362890.name: Thrash
tt32362890.description: When a Category 5 hurricane decimates a coastal town, the storm surge brings devastation, chaos and something far more frightening: hungry sharks.

tt36352591.name: You, Me & Tuscany
tt36352591.description: When a woman crashes at an empty Italian villa posing as the owner's fiancée, she discovers an unexpected romance that could transform her life.

tt23724682.name: Outcome
tt23724682.description: Hollywood star Reef is forced to confront his problems and atone for his past after being threatened by bizarre video footage from his past.

tt37605896.name: S4: The Bob Lazar Story
tt37605896.description: From jet engines to Los Alamos, Bob Lazar's life is rooted in science. In 1988, hired at S4 near Area 51, he reverse-engineered alien tech. Narrated by Lazar, this film uses exclusive footage to reveal America's best-kept secret.

tt36841098.name: Bone Keeper
tt36841098.description: Six young friends investigate missing persons cases in a remote cave system, unaware they're being stalked by an ancient creature lurking in the depths.

tt39465484.name: Eat Pray Bark
tt39465484.description: Five eccentric dog owners seek support for their four-legged friends. Their last chance: An intensive training with a legendary dog trainer in the Tyrolean mountains.

tt34966562.name: The Christophers
tt34966562.description: The children of a once famous artist hire a forger to complete some unfinished, long ago abandoned canvases so they'll have an inheritance when he dies.

tt32155665.name: 53 Sundays
tt32155665.description: Three brothers, meet to discuss about their octogenarian father, who has started showing strange behavior.

tt30691214.name: Forbidden Fruits
tt30691214.description: At a mall store, Apple leads a secret witch cult with coworkers Cherry and Fig. New hire Pumpkin questions their sisterhood, forcing them to confront inner darkness or meet violent ends.

tt32252801.name: Blue Heron
tt32252801.description: A family of six moves into a new home on Vancouver Island, but the eldest son's disruptive behavior gradually throws their lives off balance.

tt38792109.name: Bonolota Express
tt38792109.description: On a foggy winter journey, the Bonolota Express carries strangers burdened by secrets whose lives begin to collide within the train’s confined corridors. As the night unfolds, personal and political crises erupt, exposing hidden grief, moral decay, and moments of unexpected compassion amid chaos and revolt. By dawn, the train moves on, leaving its passengers irrevocably changed by a single journey where illusions collapse and human truths emerge.

tt28088049.name: Bitter Christmas
tt28088049.description: In 2004, an ad director faces a turbulent Christmas weekend. In 2026, a filmmaker turns her story into a screenplay, blurring the lines between reality, fiction, and the people closest to him.

tt21045208.name: Tow
tt21045208.description: The story of Amanda Ogle, a homeless Seattle woman, who fought her way out of tow-company hell to reclaim her life and car after receiving a tow bill for $21,634.

tt32880540.name: Zeta
tt32880540.description: A Spanish spy must track down a former spy involved in an undercover mission decades ago, while a Colombian agent is also after him. Secrets from the past are uncovered.

tt3515878.name: Do Not Enter
tt3515878.description: A group of explorers investigate an old abandoned hotel, encountering a strange supernatural being and a competing group searching for a legendary hidden treasure.

tt39875868.name: Korpur
tt39875868.description: In 1997, University Exam Controller Moushumi Sen disappeared amid a 50-crore scam. She fled to London, according to headlines, but a silenced police officer suspected a more sinister political conspiracy. Two decades later, journalist Anupam reopens the case, unearthing a labyrinth of institutional rot. Is she dead or hidden?

tt32572716.name: The Truth and Tragedy of Moriah Wilson
tt32572716.description: An intimate portrait of cyclist Moriah Wilson, raised by a fierce, loving family, whose singular drive propelled her to athletic brilliance before her life was tragically cut short by murder.

tt39370732.name: Bershama
tt39370732.description: A young man invents a new cheating method to escape the hell of high school, which leads him into a funny cat and mouse game with a cunning teacher.

tt9522946.name: Harvest
tt9522946.description: Based on the extraordinary true story of a German Baron in desperate need of a heart transplant. In spite of astonishing circumstances, he goes on a journey through the Black Market underbelly to find hope in the darkness.

tt8080418.name: Storm Rider: Legend of Hammerhead
tt8080418.description: 300 years after the Big Flood, the legend of an outlawed Storm Rider inspires two rebellious islanders to find out the truth about the origin of their world.

tt26678938.name: Pretty Lethal
tt26678938.description: A group of ballerinas try to escape from a remote inn after their bus breaks down on the way to a dance competition.

tt32490110.name: Slanted
tt32490110.description: An insecure Chinese-American teenager undergoes experimental surgery to appear white, hoping to secure the prom queen title and peer acceptance.

tt33303521.name: The Gates
tt33303521.description: Three friends' road trip turns terrifying when they witness a murder in a gated community. Trapped inside, hunted by residents who blame them, their bond fractures as a charismatic yet sinister patriarch closes in.

tt36971084.name: The Rise of the Red Hot Chili Peppers
tt36971084.description: Gritty, formative years of the Los Angeles band, and the influence of original guitarist Hillel Slovak, who died in 1988. It features interviews with bandmates Flea and Anthony Kiedis who discuss the band's early evolution.

tt37209937.name: Pizza Movie
tt37209937.description: High college students face an unexpectedly epic journey when they must navigate two flights of stairs to retrieve their pizza delivery, turning a simple task into a surreal adventure.

tt35892608.name: Undertone
tt35892608.description: Evy Babic, a skeptical paranormal pod-caster caring for her comatose mother, receives disturbing recordings tied to a folkloric threat, and every new file pulls her closer to fears she can no longer explain away.

tt37538172.name: Bodycam
tt37538172.description: Two police officers investigate a domestic dispute and there is an accidental shooting. Not wanting to be crucified by the public, the officers attempt to cover it up - only to uncover that the cameras aren't the only things watch...

tt40381358.name: Tavaszi szél - az ébredés
tt40381358.description: A year-long look at Péter Magyar's journey between public and private life, revealing how collaboration transforms a personal choice into a nationwide political and social movement.

tt39792948.name: Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere
tt39792948.description: The acclaimed documentarian gains rare, unrestricted access to explore a rising ultra-masculine network and its polarizing influencers.

tt29137511.name: One Piece: Into the Grand Line
tt29137511.description: The first two episodes of One Piece Season 2: Into the Grand Line screened as a movie in over 200 select theaters in the US, Canada, and Japan on March 10, 2026.

tt32639175.name: Dolly
tt32639175.description: Macy, a young woman, is abducted by a monstrous figure intent on raising her as their own child.

tt30851137.name: The Bride!
tt30851137.description: In 1930s Chicago, Frankenstein asks Dr. Euphronius to help create a companion. They give life to a murdered woman as the Bride, sparking romance, police interest, and radical social change.

tt5095076.name: Wardriver
tt5095076.description: A young hacker is lured into heisting the bank account of an unsuspecting woman.

tt24326462.name: One Mile: Chapter Two
tt24326462.description: A former special forces operative is forced back onto a remote island when a violent, secretive community takes revenge by abducting his daughter, launching a relentless hunt against enemies prepared for his every move.

tt27047903.name: Scream 7
tt27047903.description: Sidney fights to protect her daughter when Ghostface stalks their quiet Indiana town, forcing a survivor's family to confront old trauma, media spectacle, and a killer who weaponizes deep-fakes.

tt1764551.name: Psycho Killer
tt1764551.description: A police officer tracks a killer after her husband, a highway patrolman, becomes one of his victims.

tt24326458.name: One Mile
tt24326458.description: An ex-special forces operative goes off-the-grid when his daughter is kidnapped by a violent community. Alone and outnumbered, he's forced to use every skill he has to track them down, take them apart, and bring his daughter home.

tt34471850.name: Protector
tt34471850.description: Former war hero Nikki's peaceful life is shattered when her daughter is kidnapped. Thrust into the criminal underworld while hunted by cops and military, she must fight to rescue her child.

tt35669125.name: This Is Not a Test
tt35669125.description: Follows Sloane and four other students who take shelter in their high school during a zombie outbreak.

tt11173332.name: Bambukat 2
tt11173332.description: Chanan Singh returns to his village after being dismissed from the royal palace, leading to a conflict with the crown over dignity and revolution.

tt26931594.name: Man on the Run
tt26931594.description: An intimate portrait of Paul McCartney's trajectory after The Beatles, as he and his wife Linda form Wings.

tt33474179.name: Firebreak
tt33474179.description: A widow whose daughter disappears near their summer home as a wildfire rages nearby.

tt34688195.name: Couture
tt34688195.description: An American filmmaker faces challenges and self-discovery as she arrives in Paris for Fashion Week on a life-and-death journey.

tt35003538.name: Epic: Elvis Presley in Concert
tt35003538.description: Follows Elvis Presley, featuring never-before-seen footage and recordings.

tt14181714.name: The Bluff
tt14181714.description: A Caribbean woman gets her secret past revealed when her island is invaded by vicious buccaneers.

tt32649961.name: Blades of the Guardians
tt32649961.description: Dao Ma, a bounty hunter, takes a job to protect a man on the long road to the city of Chang'an. However, he discovers the person he is protecting is the empire's most wanted bounty, Zhi Shi Lang. Now, every greedy faction is after...

tt33508491.name: The Singers
tt33508491.description: An impromptu sing-off will decide the best singer in the bar tonight.

tt36935050.name: Kissing Is the Easy Part
tt36935050.description: Sean, a top student, agrees to tutor rebellious Flora for a college recommendation letter. Their growing attraction complicates more than just their academic goals.

tt28793125.name: The Swedish Connection
tt28793125.description: Swedish Foreign Ministry bureaucrat Gösta Engzell, overlooked during WWII, rescued thousands Jews while turning supposedly neutral Sweden into a moral force. His efforts challenged the status quo and left a lasting humanitarian le...

tt33603921.name: Tyler Perry's Joe's College Road Trip
tt33603921.description: Madea's brother Joe accompanies his grandson B.J. on a college road trip.

tt36331860.name: Love Me, Love Me
tt36331860.description: New at Milan's Saint Mary's, June is swept into secrets and lies: no one is who they seem, and love may hide behind the mask of the last boy she'd fall for.

tt34622232.name: F*ck Valentines Day
tt34622232.description: Gina hates her Valentine's Day birthday and travels to Greece to prevent her boyfriend's proposal. With help from vacationers Johnny and his sister Mickey, she schemes to delay it - while questioning her relationship.

tt32606470.name: Humint
tt32606470.description: An espionage action film depicting North and South Korean secret agents clashing while investigating crimes occurring on the Vladivostok border.

tt6374142.name: Misdirection
tt6374142.description: A couple's trust is tested on their last "big job", as their victim reveals a hidden agenda resulting in murder.

tt19838566.name: Kraken
tt19838566.description: A marine biologist is doing research on a fish farm when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye ca...

tt28682323.name: The Strangers: Chapter 3
tt28682323.description: In the series' most brutal chapter, Maya collides with the masked killers and finds the only way out of the nightmare...is in.

tt35303515.name: Feels Like Home
tt35303515.description: Rita, an ordinary, but lonely woman is kidnapped. Her captors are the Árpáds; they claim she is not called Rita but Szilvi, a runaway from their family. Rita eventually understands that the only way out is in - to escape she must impersonate Szilvi. The more she becomes the lost girl the more she finds out about the family - and understands that her life is on the line.

tt33029380.name: Marsupilami
tt33029380.description: A man is tasked to deliver a mysterious package from South America, only to find out he is carrying a baby Marsupilami.

tt39389929.name: The Investigation of Lucy Letby
tt39389929.description: Unseen footage and unheard insider accounts reveal the harrowing and divisive Case of Lucy Letby, the neonatal nurse convicted of fatally harming infants.

tt27564844.name: Iron Lung
tt27564844.description: In a post-apocalyptic future after "The Quiet Rapture" event, a convict explores a blood ocean on a desolate moon using a submarine called the "Iron Lung" to search for missing stars/planets.

tt35524793.name: The Moment
tt35524793.description: A rising pop star navigates the complexities of fame and industry pressure while preparing for her arena tour debut.

tt31777964.name: Guru
tt31777964.description: Follows a charismatic and manipulative self-help guru.

tt39162904.name: Queen of Chess
tt39162904.description: Hungarian chess prodigy Judit Polgár challenges champion Garry Kasparov and her controlling father over 15 years, breaking gender barriers to become the greatest female player ever and one of history's finest.

tt6341826.name: In the Blink of an Eye
tt6341826.description: Three storylines, spanning thousands of years, intersect and reflect on hope, connection and the circle of life.

tt33270103.name: Honey Bunch
tt33270103.description: When Diana wakes from a coma with memory loss, she and her husband seek experimental treatments at a remote facility. As the procedures intensify, their marriage is put to the test and Diana begins to question her husband's true m...

tt38598912.name: Skyscraper Live
tt38598912.description: Follows free soloist Alex Honnold as he attempts to climb Taipei 101, one of the world's tallest buildings, without safety equipment in a live broadcast event.

tt36580119.name: The President's Cake
tt36580119.description: In 1990s Iraq, 9-year-old Lamia must bake the President's birthday cake. She scrambles to find ingredients for this compulsory task while facing potential punishment if she fails.

tt38872297.name: Cosmic Princess Kaguya!
tt38872297.description: 17-year-old Iroha leads a busy life juggling school and part-time work. Enter Kaguya, a mysterious girl from the moon who crash-lands into her life.

tt22868010.name: Return to Silent Hill
tt22868010.description: When a man receives a mysterious letter from his lost love, he is drawn to Silent Hill, a once familiar town now consumed by darkness.

tt21272942.name: I Was a Stranger
tt21272942.description: Five strangers are pulled together, colliding on a single night where survival is uncertain.

tt39049795.name: Evil Influencer: The Jodi Hildebrandt Story
tt39049795.description: Unravel the case of Utah therapist Jodi Hildebrandt, whose child abuse arrest with parenting Youtuber Ruby Franke exposed a twisted tale of manipulation.

tt32767869.name: Ricky Gervais: Mortality
tt32767869.description: Ricky Gervais tackles life, death and the state of the world in a brutally honest special that spares no topic, even his own mortality.

tt33295741.name: Redux Redux
tt33295741.description: Irene Kelly travels through parallel universes, repeatedly killing her daughter's murderer. As she becomes consumed by vengeance, her humanity hangs in the balance.

tt34819091.name: The Testament of Ann Lee
tt34819091.description: Ann Lee, the founding leader of the Shaker Movement, is proclaimed the priestess by her church. This film depicts her establishment of a Utopian society and the Shakers' worship through song and dance, based on real events.

tt38350059.name: Buen Camino
tt38350059.description: A father leaves his comfort zone to search for his missing daughter on the Camino de Santiago. During his pilgrimage, amid blisters and unexpected encounters, he discovers much more than mere clues: he rediscovers himself.

tt38747537.name: Kapodistrias: The Governor
tt38747537.description: The story of the statesman Ioannis Kapodistrias from his time as foreign minister of Russia all the way to Greece's independence in the 1820s.

tt33244668.name: Anaconda
tt33244668.description: A group of friends are going through a mid-life crisis. They decide to remake a favorite movie from their youth but encounter unexpected events when they enter the jungle.

tt32792934.name: The Plague
tt32792934.description: A socially awkward tween endures the ruthless hierarchy at a water polo camp, his anxiety spiraling into psychological turmoil over the summer.

tt39049192.name: Even If This Love Disappears from the World Tonight
tt39049192.description: The pure and touching love story between a high school girl who suffers from anterograde amnesia, whose memories are reset when she wakes up, and an ordinary high school boy who lives a dull daily life.

tt28083456.name: Is This Thing On?
tt28083456.description: As their marriage unravels, Alex faces middle age and divorce, seeking new purpose in the New York comedy scene. Meanwhile, his wife Tess confronts sacrifices made for their family, forcing them to navigate co-parenting and identi...

tt37660887.name: Cover-Up
tt37660887.description: Seymour Hersh has been at the front lines of political journalism in the United States. Hersh's breakthrough reportage has brought to the public's attention many of the most damning constitutional wrongdoings and cover-ups.

tt39227597.name: Dave Chappelle: The Unstoppable
tt39227597.description: Facing a world gone sideways, comedy icon Dave Chappelle delivers bold truths and potent punchlines in this no-holds-barred special.

tt23173980.name: Darkness of Man
tt23173980.description: Interpol operative Russell Hatch witnesses the death of an informant when a seemingly routine raid goes wrong. Years later, he finds himself protecting the informant's son from a group of merciless gangs involved in an all-out tur...

tt38985973.name: Breakdown: 1975
tt38985973.description: In 1975, as America faced social and political upheaval, filmmakers turned chaos into art.

tt34762360.name: 10 Dance
tt34762360.description: Two expert dancers, Shinya Sugiki and Shinya Suzuki, aim to master each other's styles for a prestigious competition, but old rivalries and potential romance complicate their partnership.

tt38984577.name: Murder in Monaco
tt38984577.description: Monaco, 1999: Billionaire banker Edmond Safra is found dead in his penthouse. The documentary examines the puzzling circumstances surrounding this wealthy financier's murder.

tt23572848.name: The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants
tt23572848.description: Desperate to be a big guy, SpongeBob sets out to prove his bravery to Mr. Krabs by following the Flying Dutchman, a mysterious swashbuckling ghost pirate, to the deepest depths of the deep sea.

tt0133302.name: Strike on Iran: The Nuclear Question
tt0133302.description: Using rare on-the-ground access in Iran and in-depth forensic analysis, FRONTLINE, The Washington Post, Evident Media and Bellingcat conduct an immersive investigation of Iran’s nuclear program in the aftermath of the U.S. and Israeli strikes.

tt15678738.name: David
tt15678738.description: From his mother's songs to his clash with Goliath, David's journey from humble shepherd to anointed king tests the limits of faith, courage, and love--culminating in a battle for the soul of a kingdom.

tt35766629.name: Goodbye June
tt35766629.description: Follows a group of fractured siblings who must come together under sudden and trying circumstances.

tt23172090.name: Dust Bunny
tt23172090.description: After losing her foster parents to a bedroom-dwelling beast, young Aurora hires her reclusive neighbor, a professional assassin, to hunt it, unknowingly thrusting him into a war against both human killers and supernatural terrors.

tt30096221.name: Ella McCay
tt30096221.description: An idealistic young woman juggles her family and work life in a comedy about the people you love and how to survive them.

tt34434461.name: Tell Me Softly
tt34434461.description: Kamila's life turns upside down when the Di Bianco brothers return after 7 years. Thiago gave her first kiss, Taylor was her protector. Now she's changed, but they still have a way of getting through to her like no one else can.

tt34508974.name: Silent Night, Deadly Night
tt34508974.description: After seeing his parents killed by someone dressed as Santa, a grown man later wears a Santa suit himself and seeks violent revenge.

tt31281659.name: Merv
tt31281659.description: When their beloved dog Merv loses his spark after their split, Anna and Russ are forced into the world's most awkward co-parenting arrangement.

tt33014233.name: Gezhi Town
tt33014233.description: A group of Chinese refugees and straggler soldiers, led by a machinist, defend their mountain town, "Gezhi," against a surprise attack by Japanese reconnaissance troops in a desperate fight using civilian ingenuity against a trained military force.

tt33350512.name: 100 Nights of Hero
tt33350512.description: When a charming house guest arrives at a remote castle, the delicate dynamic between a neglectful husband, his innocent bride Cherry and their devoted maid Hero is thrown into chaos.

tt32537226.name: Hunting Season
tt32537226.description: When a reclusive survivalist and his daughter rescue a mysterious, wounded woman from a river, they become entangled in a deadly web of violence and revenge, forcing them to confront a brutal criminal to survive.

tt34886821.name: La Grazia
tt34886821.description: A widowed Italian president faces moral crises over euthanasia legislation and pardoning killers while grappling with his late wife's infidelity during his final months in office.

tt36591419.name: Man Finds Tape
tt36591419.description: After finding mysterious video clips, siblings investigate the strange recordings and uncover a disturbing secret spreading through their Texas town.

tt39075285.name: Yuki's Revenge
tt39075285.description: Visionary director Quentin Tarantino had a dream of a Kill Bill chapter that never made it to the silver screen, a chapter known as "Yuki's Revenge."

tt3331548.name: Not Without Hope
tt3331548.description: A group of friends' fishing boat capsizes during a storm in the Gulf of Mexico and they're left alone stranded at sea and struggling for survival.

tt19848676.name: Riley
tt19848676.description: The life of a disciplined high school athlete begins to unravel when his queer identity competes against the idea of who he was supposed to be.

tt32641442.name: Merrily We Roll Along
tt32641442.description: Spanning three decades, the turbulent relationship between a composer and his two lifelong friends, a writer and a lyricist and playwright.

tt34991535.name: Stromberg - Wieder alles wie immer
tt34991535.description: About twenty years ago, Germany got to know Bernd Stromberg and his team from the claims department at CAPITOL Insurance. Back then, there was nothing vegan in the cafeteria, and bullying and sexism were commonplace in the office. Since then, the world of work has changed enormously. But has Bernd Stromberg changed too?

tt36956674.name: I'm Chevy Chase and You're Not

tt31998881.name: Oh. What. Fun.
tt31998881.description: Claire plans a special Christmas, but is forgotten by her family. When they realize that she's missing, their holiday is at risk until she returns to give them the celebration they deserve.

tt30274401.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 2

tt43739386.name: V/H/S/Mixtape
tt43739386.description: It presents a new anthology in which music and sound become a source of terror.

tt40224399.name: Untold: Chess Mates
tt40224399.description: Magnus Carlsen, widely regarded as the greatest chess player of all time, is challenged by Hans Niemann, a rising star who capitalizes on the meteoric growth of online chess. Niemann’s ascension culminated in an epic, controversy-shrouded victory over Carlsen at the 2022 Sinquefield Cup, which eventually led to allegations and revelations of cheating. Determined to clear his name, Niemann fights his way back to the top of the chess world, setting the stage for a high-stakes rematch with Carlsen in 2024.

tt38589464.name: Feel My Voice
tt38589464.description: A teenager, the only hearing member of a deaf family, finds her voice and learns to believe in herself through her passion for singing.

tt37961727.name: A Time for Bravery
tt37961727.description: A psychoanalyst is sentenced to community service following a traffic accident and is assigned to provide therapeutic support to a police agent devastated by his wife's infidelity. The two will face unimaginable dangers together.

tt1013743.name: Knight and Day
tt1013743.description: A young woman gets mixed up with a disgraced spy who is trying to clear his name.

tt0449088.name: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End
tt0449088.description: Will Turner, Elizabeth Swann, Hector Barbossa, and the crew of the Black Pearl try and rescue Jack from Davy Jones's locker, and prepare to fight Lord Cutler Beckett, who controls Davy Jones and the Flying Dutchman.

tt3704428.name: Elvis
tt3704428.description: The life of American music icon Elvis Presley, from his childhood to becoming a rock and movie star in the 1950s while maintaining a complex relationship with his manager, Colonel Tom Parker.

tt6718170.name: The Super Mario Bros. Movie
tt6718170.description: Brooklyn plumbers Mario and Luigi are warped to the magical Mushroom Kingdom, and Mario must team up with Princess Peach, Toad, and Donkey Kong to save Luigi from the evil Bowser.

tt0499448.name: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
tt0499448.description: The Pevensie siblings return to Narnia, where they are enlisted to help ward off an evil king and restore the rightful heir to the land's throne, Prince Caspian.

tt1190539.name: The Chaser
tt1190539.description: A disgraced ex-policeman who runs a small ring of prostitutes finds himself in a race against time when one of his women goes missing.

tt0955308.name: Robin Hood
tt0955308.description: In twelfth-century England, Robin Longstride and his band of marauders confront corruption in a local village and lead an uprising against the crown that will forever alter the balance of world power.

tt0050212.name: The Bridge on the River Kwai
tt0050212.description: British POWs are forced to build a railway bridge across the river Kwai for their Japanese captors in occupied Burma, not knowing that the allied forces are planning a daring commando raid through the jungle to destroy it.

tt10403420.name: Terrifier 2
tt10403420.description: Resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County to terrorize a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween night.

tt1189340.name: The Lincoln Lawyer
tt1189340.description: A defense lawyer lands a case defending a wealthy realtor's son who is accused of raping a prostitute, but he genuinely believes his client to be innocent and intends to prove it.

tt44822485.name: Norm: The Tale of Norm MacDonald
tt44822485.description: Judd Apatow's documentary on Norm Macdonald uses archival footage, photos, and home videos to chronicle the SNL legend's career—from "Weekend Update" anchor to master of absurd, deadpan comedy whose influence endures.

tt0094737.name: Big
tt0094737.description: After wishing to be made big, a teenage boy wakes the next morning to find himself mysteriously in the body of an adult.

tt0118571.name: Air Force One
tt0118571.description: The US President must save himself and his family when Air Force One is hijacked by communist radicals with them on board.

tt1228705.name: Iron Man 2
tt1228705.description: With the world now aware of his identity as Iron Man, Tony Stark must contend with both his declining health and a vengeful madman with ties to his father's legacy.

tt2510894.name: Hotel Transylvania 2
tt2510894.description: Dracula and his friends try to bring out the monster in his half human, half vampire grandson in order to keep Mavis from leaving the hotel.

tt0210070.name: Ginger Snaps
tt0210070.description: Two death-obsessed sisters, outcasts in their suburban neighborhood, must deal with the tragic consequences when one of them is bitten by a deadly werewolf.

tt8332922.name: A Quiet Place Part II
tt8332922.description: Following the events at home, the Abbott family now face the terrors of the outside world. Forced to venture into the unknown, they realize the creatures that hunt by sound are not the only threats lurking beyond the sand path.

tt0090863.name: The Color of Money
tt0090863.description: Fast Eddie Felson teaches a cocky but immensely talented protégé the ropes of pool hustling, which in turn inspires him to make an unlikely comeback.

tt5220122.name: Hotel Transylvania 3: Summer Vacation
tt5220122.description: Count Dracula and company participate in a cruise for sea-loving monsters, unaware that their boat is being commandeered by the monster-hating Van Helsing family.

tt36586751.name: The Holy Grill
tt36586751.description: At a tennis club in rural Germany, preparations for the summer party are led by Heribert. When a separate grill is suggested for Erol, the club's only Muslim member, tensions flare. What begins as a simple discussion quickly turns into a debate about societal and personal conflicts, threatening to tear the club apart.

tt49058294.name: Remain Calm
tt49058294.description: The story follows the two gas station clerks whose routine night shift turns into a fight for survival. A government agent warns them about Mr. Frett, a terrifying creature that tracks and hunts people who show any signs of anxiety, stress, or panic. To stay alive, the characters must force themselves into a state of aggressive positivity and calm.

tt32299316.name: Dangerous Animals
tt32299316.description: When Zephyr, a savvy and free-spirited surfer, is abducted by a shark-obsessed serial killer and held captive on his boat, she must figure out how to escape before he carries out a ritualistic feeding to the sharks below.

tt25470468.name: Beyond Utopia
tt25470468.description: The story of several families as they attempt to escape oppression in North Korea, revealing a world most of us have never seen.

tt38672588.name: Masterplan
tt38672588.description: A master thief enlists two strangers for a Louvre heist targeting the Mona Lisa, then reveals they're his children and siblings who must cooperate to pull off history's greatest art theft.

tt36980182.name: The Incomer
tt36980182.description: On a remote Scottish isle, siblings Isla and Sandy hunt birds and talk to mythical beings while fighting off outsiders. Their lives change when Daniel, an awkward official, arrives to relocate them.

tt0070723.name: Soylent Green
tt0070723.description: A nightmarish futuristic fantasy about the controlling power of big corporations and an innocent cop who stumbles on the truth.

tt2381111.name: Brooklyn
tt2381111.description: An Irish immigrant lands in 1950s Brooklyn, where she quickly falls into a romance with a local. When her past catches up with her, however, she must choose between two countries and the lives that exist within.

tt14509110.name: No One Will Save You
tt14509110.description: An exiled anxiety-ridden homebody must battle an alien who's found its way into her home.

tt0120102.name: Seven Years in Tibet
tt0120102.description: Heinrich Harrer, an Austrian climber and Nazi supporter, breaks out of a British POW camp in India and treks to the holy city of Lhasa where he's employed as an instructor to the young 14th Dalai Lama and soon becomes his close co...

tt0399201.name: The Island
tt0399201.description: In 2019, a mercenary pursues a man and woman who escaped a research facility after learning their true fate.

tt0105323.name: Scent of a Woman
tt0105323.description: A young prep student takes a job as an assistant to a blind, irritable, retired Army lieutenant colonel over Thanksgiving weekend.

tt35856037.name: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
tt35856037.description: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

tt36842933.name: Just an Illusion
tt36842933.description: In 1985 suburban Paris, 12-year-old Vincent lives with his distant older brother and quarrelling parents. Amid laughter and unease, he navigates friendship and first love, while beginning to confront the adult world.

tt37818327.name: The Sun Never Sets
tt37818327.description: A woman's relationship with her older, divorced boyfriend hits a rough patch just as her ex reappears in her life, leading to complicated emotions and messy entanglements in the Alaskan wilderness.

tt5672290.name: The First Omen
tt5672290.description: A young American woman is sent to Rome to begin a life of service to the church, but encounters a darkness that causes her to question her faith and uncovers a terrifying conspiracy that hopes to bring about the birth of evil inca...

tt2119543.name: The House with a Clock in Its Walls
tt2119543.description: A young orphan named Lewis Barnavelt aids his magical uncle in locating a clock with the power to bring about the end of the world.

tt2312718.name: Homefront
tt2312718.description: A former DEA agent moves his family to a quiet town, where he soon tangles with a local meth druglord.

tt0234215.name: The Matrix Reloaded
tt0234215.description: Freedom fighters Neo, Trinity and Morpheus continue to lead the revolt against the Machine Army, unleashing their arsenal of extraordinary skills and weaponry against the systematic forces of repression and exploitation.

tt14230388.name: Asteroid City
tt14230388.description: World-changing events spectacularly disrupt the annual Asteroid Day celebration in an American desert town.

tt0457939.name: The Holiday
tt0457939.description: Amanda lives in LA and is a movie trailer editor. Iris lives in Surrey and is a journalist. The two decide to swap houses for two weeks at Christmas - both trying to forget their troubled love lives, until love finds them anyway.

tt8228288.name: The Platform
tt8228288.description: In a prison where inmates are fed on a descending platform, those on the upper levels take more than their fair share while those below are left to starve on scraps and one man decides to change the system.

tt36841161.name: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
tt36841161.description: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

tt0206275.name: Save the Last Dance
tt0206275.description: A white midwestern girl moves to Chicago, where her new boyfriend is a black teen from the South Side with a rough, semi-criminal past.

tt0309593.name: Final Destination 2
tt0309593.description: Death is stalking Kimberly Corman and multiple survivors of a deadly highway accident.

tt1371111.name: Cloud Atlas
tt1371111.description: As souls are born and reborn, they renew their connections to one another throughout the ages.

tt0088727.name: Anne of Green Gables
tt0088727.description: Anne Shirley, an orphan, is fostered by farmer Matthew Cuthbert and his sister Marilla, who were expecting a boy to be sent them to help with their farm work. They accept Anne, who quickly endears herself to them and to the local villagers.

tt0089881.name: Ran
tt0089881.description: In Medieval Japan, an elderly warlord retires, handing over his empire to his three sons. However, he vastly underestimates how the new-found power will corrupt them and cause them to turn on each other...and him.

tt0349683.name: King Arthur
tt0349683.description: A demystified take on the tale of King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table.

tt7557108.name: Saint Maud
tt7557108.description: A pious nurse becomes dangerously obsessed with saving the soul of her dying patient.

tt1365519.name: Tomb Raider
tt1365519.description: Lara Croft, the fiercely independent daughter of a missing adventurer, must push herself beyond her limits when she discovers the island where her father, Lord Richard Croft disappeared.

tt0109506.name: The Crow
tt0109506.description: The night before his wedding, musician Eric Draven and his fiancée are brutally murdered by members of a violent gang. On the anniversary of their death, Eric rises from the grave and assumes the mantle of the Crow, a supernatural...

tt3215824.name: Those Who Wish Me Dead
tt3215824.description: A teenage murder witness finds himself pursued by twin assassins in the Montana wilderness with a survival expert tasked with protecting him -- and a forest fire threatening to consume them all.

tt28249919.name: Presence
tt28249919.description: A family becomes convinced they are not alone after moving into their new home in the suburbs.

tt1289401.name: Ghostbusters
tt1289401.description: Following a ghost invasion of Manhattan, paranormal enthusiasts Erin Gilbert and Abby Yates, nuclear engineer Jillian Holtzmann, and subway worker Patty Tolan band together to stop the otherworldly threat.

tt0493464.name: Wanted
tt0493464.description: A frustrated office worker discovers that he is the son of a professional assassin, and that he shares his father's superhuman killing abilities.

tt0107614.name: Mrs. Doubtfire
tt0107614.description: After a bitter divorce, an actor disguises himself as a female housekeeper to spend time with his children held in custody by his former wife.

tt0017136.name: Metropolis
tt0017136.description: In a futuristic city sharply divided between the working class and the city planners, the son of the city's mastermind falls in love with a working-class prophet who predicts the coming of a savior to mediate their differences.

tt0980970.name: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader
tt0980970.description: Lucy and Edmund Pevensie return to Narnia with their cousin Eustace where they sail with King Caspian to help Narnian lords banished by an evil usurper of the throne.

tt11729298.name: American Underdog
tt11729298.description: The story of NFL MVP and Hall of Fame quarterback Kurt Warner, who went from stocking shelves at a supermarket to becoming an American Football star.

tt0083190.name: Thief
tt0083190.description: After years in prison, ace safe-cracker Frank owns a car dealership and a cocktail lounge, which are fronts for high-stakes jewelry heists. He wants to complete one last big heist for the Mob before he goes straight.

tt1966604.name: The Imposter
tt1966604.description: A documentary centered on a young man in Spain who claims to a grieving Texas family that he is their 16-year-old son who has been missing for 3 years.

tt0276816.name: Below
tt0276816.description: The crew of a U.S. Navy submarine in World War II rescues survivors from a sunken ship, only to face a series of mysterious deaths and supernatural occurrences.

tt6714432.name: The Loud House Movie
tt6714432.description: With his parents and all 10 sisters in tow, Lincoln Loud heads to Scotland and learns that royalty runs in the family in this global musical journey.

tt34890576.name: Clayface
tt34890576.description: Rising Hollywood star Matt Hagen descends into a horrifying revenge-filled monster when scientific ambition strips him of his identity and humanity.

tt39833109.name: Salmokji: Whispering Water
tt39833109.description: An incident unfolds when a film crew goes to a reservoir to update the road view where an unidentified figure was filmed, and they encounter something in the dark, deep waters.

tt36589928.name: Our Hero, Balthazar
tt36589928.description: Follows a wealthy New York City teenager who, eager to impress his activist crush, follows an online connection to Texas where he believes he can stop an act of extreme violence.

tt22772712.name: Murder at the Embassy
tt22772712.description: 1934. A private detective, Miranda Green investigates a murder perpetrated in the British Embassy in Cairo, where a top secret document was stolen, risking to jeopardize both Buckingham Palace and the peace of the world.

tt32358390.name: The Cycle
tt32358390.description: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.

tt21188080.name: Lisa Frankenstein
tt21188080.description: A coming of RAGE love story about a teenager and her crush, who happens to be a corpse. After a set of horrific circumstances bring him back to life, the two embark on a journey to find love, happiness - and a few missing body parts.

tt8488126.name: The Inventor: Out for Blood in Silicon Valley
tt8488126.description: The story of Theranos, a multi-billion dollar tech company, its founder Elizabeth Holmes, the youngest self-made female billionaire, and the massive fraud that collapsed the company.

tt2056785.name: Wildwood
tt2056785.description: The adventures of Prue McKeel as she sets off to the forests outside Portland to find her kidnapped brother.

tt43617372.name: You+Me - Against the World
tt43617372.description: Alma Lancaster, conceals her filmmaking ambitions from her rich family who believe she's in law school. She falls for rebel Vadim Arcadi, while creating a student film. Someone observes, poised to reveal secrets that could destroy...

tt33586629.name: Primavera
tt33586629.description: A talented violinist, Cecilia, confined in an orphanage, meets Vivaldi who becomes her teacher. Under his mentorship and through his music, she gains courage to break free from the life she was destined for and pursue her passion.

tt32499579.name: Haunted Hotel
tt32499579.description: A single mom with two kids operates a haunted hotel, aided by her late brother's ghost who believes they can have ingenious ideas despite his ethereal state.

tt1856101.name: Blade Runner 2049
tt1856101.description: Young Blade Runner K's discovery of a long-buried secret leads him to track down former Blade Runner Rick Deckard, who's been missing for thirty years.

tt0207201.name: What Women Want
tt0207201.description: A cocky, chauvinistic advertising executive magically acquires the ability to hear what women are thinking.

tt0050976.name: The Seventh Seal
tt0050976.description: A knight returning to Sweden after the Crusades seeks answers about life, death, and the existence of God as he plays chess against the Grim Reaper during the Black Plague.

tt4062536.name: Green Room
tt4062536.description: A punk rock band is forced to fight for survival after witnessing something they shouldn't have at a neo-Nazi skinhead bar.

tt0443453.name: Borat
tt0443453.description: Kazakh TV talking head Borat is dispatched to the United States to report on the greatest country in the world.

tt1212450.name: Lawless
tt1212450.description: Set in Depression-era Franklin County, Virginia, a trio of bootlegging brothers is threatened by a new special deputy and other authorities angling for a cut of their profits.

tt0212338.name: Meet the Parents
tt0212338.description: A chronic underachiever meets his girlfriend's parents before proposing, but unfortunately for him her father is an overprotective former CIA agent.

tt5886440.name: Marrowbone
tt5886440.description: A young man and his three younger siblings, who have kept secret the death of their beloved mother in order to remain together, are plagued by a sinister presence in the sprawling manor in which they live.

tt0253556.name: Reign of Fire
tt0253556.description: A brood of fire-breathing dragons emerges from the earth and begins setting everything ablaze, establishing dominance over the planet.

tt4425200.name: John Wick: Chapter 2
tt4425200.description: After returning to the criminal underworld to repay a debt, John Wick discovers that a large bounty has been put on his life.

tt16277242.name: Society of the Snow
tt16277242.description: The flight of a rugby team crashes on a glacier in the Andes. The few passengers who survive the crash find themselves in one of the world's toughest environments to survive.

tt36271247.name: Clean Hands
tt36271247.description: The inspirational true story of hero drug cop turned recovery advocate Kevin Simmers and his daughter Brooke. The film examines the American drug crisis from the opposing eyes of cop and addict who were also father and daughter.

tt21285562.name: The Dog Stars
tt21285562.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a virus wipes out humanity. Survivors face roaming scavengers called Reapers. Protagonist Hig, a pilot, survived the flu but lost his wife.

tt14647404.name: Cat Person
tt14647404.description: When a college sophomore goes on a date with an older man, she finds that he doesn't live up to the guy she has been flirting with over texts.

tt0069704.description: A group of teenagers in California's central valley spend one final night after their 1962 high school graduation cruising the strip with their buddies before they pursue their varying goals.

tt0364725.name: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
tt0364725.description: A group of misfits enter a Las Vegas dodgeball tournament in order to save their cherished local gym from the onslaught of a corporate health fitness chain.

tt0422720.name: Marie Antoinette
tt0422720.description: The retelling of France's iconic but ill-fated queen, Marie Antoinette. From her betrothal and marriage to Louis XVI at 14 to her reign as queen at 19 and to the end of her reign as queen, and ultimately the fall of Versailles.

tt0103639.name: Aladdin
tt0103639.description: A kind-hearted street urchin and a power-hungry Grand Vizier vie for a magic lamp that has the power to make their deepest wishes come true.

tt13433802.name: A Quiet Place: Day One
tt13433802.description: A young woman named Sam finds herself trapped in New York City during the early stages of an invasion by alien creatures with ultra-sensitive hearing.

tt14253846.name: Speak No Evil
tt14253846.description: A Danish family visits a Dutch family they met on a holiday. What was supposed to be an idyllic weekend slowly starts unraveling as the Danes try to stay polite in the face of unpleasantness.

tt10431500.name: Miracle in Cell No. 7
tt10431500.description: A story of love between a mentally-ill father who was wrongly accused of murder and his lovely six year old daughter. Prison will be their home. Based on the 2013 Korean movie Miracle in Cell No. 7 (2013).

tt6823368.name: Glass
tt6823368.description: A security guard uses his superhuman abilities to track down a disturbed man with twenty-four personalities.

tt0081398.name: Raging Bull
tt0081398.description: The life of boxer Jake LaMotta, whose violence and temper that led him to the top in the ring destroyed his life outside of it.

tt1213663.name: The World's End
tt1213663.description: Five friends who reunite in an attempt to top their epic pub crawl from twenty years earlier unwittingly become humanity's only hope for survival.

tt0056193.name: Lolita
tt0056193.description: A middle-aged college professor becomes infatuated with a 14-year-old girl.

tt0448115.name: Shazam!
tt0448115.description: A newly fostered young boy in search of his mother instead finds unexpected super powers and soon gains a powerful enemy.

tt5034838.name: Godzilla vs. Kong
tt5034838.description: The epic next chapter in the cinematic Monsterverse pits two of the greatest icons in motion picture history against each other--the fearsome Godzilla and the mighty Kong--with humanity caught in the balance.

tt2310332.name: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
tt2310332.description: Bilbo Baggins and company are forced to engage in a war against an array of combatants and keep the Lonely Mountain from falling into the hands of a rising darkness.

tt38365045.name: Mudborn
tt38365045.description: A video-game designer's will is tested when a mysterious spirit infiltrates his new family and threatens the life of his expecting wife.

tt13622970.name: Moana 2

tt1379182.name: Dogtooth
tt1379182.description: A controlling, manipulative father locks his three adult offspring in a state of perpetual childhood by keeping them prisoner within the sprawling family compound.

tt0914798.name: The Boy in the Striped Pajamas
tt0914798.description: Through the innocent eyes of Bruno, the eight-year-old son of the commandant at a German concentration camp, a forbidden friendship with a Jewish boy on the other side of the camp fence has startling and unexpected consequences.

tt29611136.name: Wicker
tt29611136.description: An ostracized fisherwoman commissions the local basketmaker to weave her a husband, but when her wicker creation proves unexpectedly extraordinary, his presence ignites jealousy and upheaval that threatens their quiet village.

tt37070354.name: The Storm
tt37070354.description: Filip is turning 45, and has invited his closest friends for dinner at his and his wife's lavish and newly bought farm estate up north in Sweden. What they don't know is that a ferocious storm is on its way and that they'll be tra...

tt8760666.name: Truly Naked
tt8760666.description: An introverted teen, who has only ever experienced sex through the lens while working for his father’s pornography business, must step out from behind the camera when a feisty classmate challenges him to embrace a real connection.

tt0054953.name: The Guns of Navarone
tt0054953.description: A team of Allied saboteurs is assigned an impossible mission: infiltrate an impregnable Nazi-held Greek island and destroy the two enormous long-range field guns that prevent the rescue of 2,000 trapped British soldiers.

tt32149847.name: Drop
tt32149847.description: A widowed mother's first date in years takes a terrifying turn when she's bombarded with anonymous threatening messages on her phone during their upscale dinner, leaving her questioning if her charming date is behind the harassment.

tt11655566.name: Lilo & Stitch
tt11655566.description: A lonely Hawaiian girl befriends a runaway alien, helping to mend her fragmented family.

tt0115736.name: Bound
tt0115736.description: Tough ex-con Corky and her lover Violet concoct a scheme to steal millions of stashed mob money and pin the blame on Violet's crooked boyfriend Caesar.

tt43655467.name: Ali G: Who Iz I?
tt43655467.description: Hip-hop journalist Ali G returns after 20 years to make a documentary with real people. Cameras follow him for over a year as he takes classes, walks the streets, and appears on shows, often with his pregnant girlfriend.

tt37775809.name: The Musical
tt37775809.description: Doug, a frustrated playwright and middle school theater teacher, learns his ex is dating his nemesis, the school principal. To get revenge and cost him a Blue Ribbon Award, Doug secretly stages the most inappropriate play imaginable.

tt0295700.name: Wrong Turn
tt0295700.description: Chris and a group of five friends are left stranded deep in the middle of the woods after their cars collide. As they venture deeper into the woods, they face an uncertain and bloodcurdling fate.

tt22687790.name: A Haunting in Venice
tt22687790.description: In post-World War II Venice, Poirot, now retired and living in his own exile, reluctantly attends a seance. But when one of the guests is murdered, it is up to the former detective to once again uncover the killer.

tt0119167.name: Funny Games
tt0119167.description: Two violent young men take a mother, father, and son hostage in their vacation cabin and force them to play sadistic "games" with one another for their own amusement.

tt1800241.name: American Hustle
tt1800241.description: Two con artists are forced to work for a wild FBI agent who pushes them into a world of Jersey powerbrokers and the Mafia.

tt0051201.name: Witness for the Prosecution
tt0051201.description: A veteran British barrister must defend his client in a murder trial that has surprise after surprise.

tt0122690.name: Ronin
tt0122690.description: A freelancing former U.S. intelligence agent is hired as part of a team to steal a mysterious package that's wanted by both the IRA and Russian mercenaries.

tt0072890.name: Dog Day Afternoon
tt0072890.description: Three amateur robbers plan to hold up a Brooklyn bank. A nice, simple robbery: Walk in, take the money, and run. Unfortunately, the supposedly uncomplicated heist suddenly becomes a bizarre nightmare as everything that could go wr...

tt0439815.name: Slither
tt0439815.description: A small town is taken over by an alien plague, turning residents into zombies and all forms of mutant monsters.

tt1124035.name: The Ides of March

tt11897478.description: Two men who meet on a bus strike up a conversation that turns into friendship. For Henry Teague, worn down by a lifetime of physical labour and crime, this is a dream come true.

tt0089907.name: The Return of the Living Dead

tt0095444.name: Killer Klowns from Outer Space

tt4196848.name: Mr. Church

tt11744496.name: One Piece: Episode of Skypiea

The island of Skypiea and its grand city of gold await among the clouds, but a clash of winged clans and a man who calls himself God won’t make things easy! Only Luffy can resist this God’s mighty power and light the mysteries of the past.

tt11757066.name: One Piece Episode of East Blue
tt11757066.description: Experience the inspiring moments that launched Luffy and the first four members of his crew on their grand adventure to find the One Piece! It’s all here—from Shanks giving Luffy the straw hat, to Nami facing the Fish-Men at her hometown. Along the way, Zoro finds his swordsman’s zeal, Usopp pays for his pranks, and Sanji sizzles up the Baratie. Join the crew where it all began in the waters of East Blue.

tt9534948.name: Fate/Grand Order the Movie: Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot
tt9534948.description: Chaldea agents Ritsuka Fujimaru and Mash Kyrielight travel to Camelot and encounter the heroes of that realm.

tt7978758.name: Apollo 10½: A Space Age Childhood
tt7978758.description: A coming-of-age story set in the suburbs of Houston, Texas in the summer of 1969, centered around the historic Apollo 11 moon landing.

tt13676256.name: Scooby-Doo! The Sword and the Scoob
tt13676256.description: An evil sorceress transports the gang back to the age chivalrous knights, spell-casting wizards, and fire-breathing dragons.

tt10736506.name: The Testament of Sister New Devil: Departures
tt10736506.description: After being branded a potential threat by the hero village, Basara returns home with his companions, where their bonds deepen amid growing tension over a summons to face the elders.  Encouraged by Chisato and strengthened by his friends, Basara overcomes a trial that forces him to confront his doubts and accept that he doesn’t have to fight alone. United in resolve, the group sets out together for the hero village, ready to face what lies ahead.

tt12885852.name: Batman: Soul of the Dragon
tt12885852.description: In the 1970s, a missing teacher of martial arts is the subject of a quest by his devoted and brilliant but distant students, who include Batman.

tt7014378.name: The Summit of the Gods
tt7014378.description: A photojournalist's obsessive quest for the truth about the first expedition to Mt. Everest leads him to search for an esteemed climber who went missing.

tt13064272.name: Sing a Bit of Harmony
tt13064272.description: The story of a new robot transfer student interested in her surroundings and a song that brings happiness to her and her classmates.

tt13428402.name: Stand by Me Doraemon 2
tt13428402.description: Nobita travels to the future to show his beloved grandma his bride, but adult Nobita has fled his own wedding. Can he ever be a good husband to Shizuka?

tt14030488.name: My Fat Arse and I
tt14030488.description: One morning, a girl tries on a pair of new pants, but they won’t zip up. In the mirror she sees herself as the fattest piglet the world has ever seen. To change this, she decides to go on a strict diet. Hunger quickly turns her into a kind of zombie, stumbling blindly to the fridge that seems to haunt her at night. In one of those moments, the Angel of the United Bitches of Slimbuttlandia appears, carrying a royal invitation to visit the kingdom and take part in a mysterious royal ceremony.

tt11177804.name: Jiang Ziya
tt11177804.description: Banished to the mortal world, a warrior has to slay a demon to return to the heavenly realm and become a god.

tt12851396.name: Trollhunters: Rise of the Titans
tt12851396.description: The heroes from the Trollhunters series team-up on an epic adventure to fight the Arcane Order for control over the magic that binds them all.

tt13269670.name: New Gods: Nezha Reborn
tt13269670.description: A normal young deliveryman Li Yunxiang, though coming from the slum area, is living a satisfying life but when the arrogant wealthy son of Boss beats him down, his deep anger turns into a blast of Truth Fire.

tt13276012.name: Poupelle of Chimney Town
tt13276012.description: A factory town is covered by chimney smoke, and as the townspeople haven't see the sky in centuries, they no longer believe that stars exist. A chimney sweep and a friendly monster named Poupelle decide to prove that stars are real.

tt14324650.name: Batman: The Long Halloween, Part One
tt14324650.description: Held hostage by the powerful Falcone crime family, Gotham City is rife with crime and corruption. Adding to the chaos is the mysterious Holiday killer, who has been targeting the underworld and leaving a trail of terror - and body...

tt13804084.name: Justice Society: World War II
tt13804084.description: The Justice Society of America, a group of heroes aiding the allies in World War 2, acquire an ally from the future who sends them on an adventure that changes history.

tt14402926.name: Batman: The Long Halloween, Part Two
tt14402926.description: The killer known as Holiday continues to stalk the Falcone crime family while a new class of costumed criminal rises in Gotham City. Batman suspects that a former ally might be the serial killer.

tt14813816.name: Niko: Beyond the Northern Lights
tt14813816.description: Niko the reindeer joins his father in Santa's Flying Forces, but when Santa's sleigh is stolen by an acquaintance, Niko must find it in time for Christmas.

tt10483152.name: Unicorn Wars
tt10483152.description: War-hungry teddy bears journey from bootcamp to the psychedelic terrors of the Magic Forest in this darkly beautiful horror animation.

tt13021784.description: Alice lives at her parents' place at the age of 27 with no private life or a relationship. It takes a bicycle accident and a short coma to make her realize that it's time to move out.

tt11952320.name: To: Gerard
tt11952320.description: A sprightly elderly man brightens the day of a little girl through magic.

tt12439248.name: Pompo the Cinephile
tt12439248.description: Operating out of the movie capital "Nyallywood," Pompo has been shooting one B-grade entertainment flick after another that anyone would enjoy. One day, Pompo's "movie buff" assistant Gene spots a new script written by Pompo and is moved by its exquisite story. In a fit of passion, he proclaims, "I want to see this as a finished work in theaters as soon as possible!"  However, Pompo tells him, "So you shoot this film." Thus, Gene takes on his first directing gig. Meanwhile, Natalie, an ordinary girl who just arrived in town with movie actress dreams, has been discovered by Pompo...

tt13288678.name: Mobile Suit Gundam: Hathaway
tt13288678.description: Hathaway Noa, still haunted by his past actions, joins a terrorist organization called Mufti and adopts the alias "Mufti Nabiyy Erin". Mufti is fighting a terrorist campaign against the Earth Federation government.

tt2049430.name: Digimon Adventure
tt2049430.description: Two children receive a strange egg that hatches into their very first Digimon, leading to the night that would change their lives forever.

tt0440972.name: The Meaning of Life
tt0440972.description: A sprawling look at the evolution of humankind, over the course of a billion years.

tt0140821.name: Asparagus
tt0140821.description: A symbolic reflection on issues of female sexuality, art and identity constructs.

tt0144618.name: The Spirit of Christmas
tt0144618.description: Four children, all but one of whom go unnamed, build a snowman which comes to life and threatens their town. Kenny, the only child whose name is given in the film, and who resembles the character called Cartman in the subsequent S...

tt3419296.name: Sinbad and the Cyclops Island
tt3419296.description: Marina, Sinbad and his crew are resting on a small island. They soon find out they're not alone.

tt3889320.name: BoOzy’ OS and the Cristal Gem
tt3889320.description: Coming from outer space, an intergalactic cow invites BoOzy’ OS to join the biggest animation film festival of the universe. BoOzy’ imagines himself winning the competition and decides to seek the famous "Cristal" of Annecy, with the help of OSmic the Hedgeh' OS and other cool dudes. But the dark paunchy Mari' OS is determined to recover the loot before him.

tt0041169.name: Begone Dull Care
tt0041169.description: In this extraordinary short animation, Evelyn Lambart and Norman McLaren painted colours, shapes, and transformations directly onto their filmstrip. The result is a vivid interpretation, in fluid lines and colour, of jazz music played by the Oscar Peterson Trio.

tt0311618.name: A Tree of Palme
tt0311618.description: Palme is a puppet created by a man for his sickly wife. After her death, Palme becomes paralyzed with sorrow until he happens to cross paths with a woman being pursued who asks him to deliver something precious to a sacred place c...

tt0174834.name: The Pied Piper
tt0174834.description: The story of the Pied Piper of Hamelin with a twist.

tt13645944.name: Revival of Evangelion
tt13645944.description: Revival of Evangelion is a re-edit of the Neon Genesis Evangelion films , released in 1998. It consists of Evangelion: Death (which was essentially a clip show that summarized the entire regular series) and The End of Evangelion , re-edited together to make a version that tells the entire story of Evangelion. It is considered to be the final form of the Evangelion films.

tt14039636.name: Opera
tt14039636.description: Our society and history, which is filled with beauty and absurdity.

tt11332850.name: Robin Robin
tt11332850.description: In this stop-motion short film, a bird raised by mice begins to question where she belongs and sets off on a daring journey of self-discovery.

tt1295071.name: Tales of the Black Freighter
tt1295071.description: A mariner survives an attack from the dreaded pirates of the Black Freighter, but his struggle to return home to warn it has a horrific cost.

tt10101702.name: My Little Pony: A New Generation
tt10101702.description: After the time of the Mane 6, Sunny--a young Earth Pony--and her new Unicorn friend Izzy explore their world and strive to restore Harmony to Equestria.

tt13260836.name: Angela's Christmas Wish
tt13260836.description: A sequel to the much loved Angela's Christmas, Angela's Christmas Wish is a heart-warming tale of a determined little girl who sets out to reunite her family in time for Christmas.

tt11332750.name: Alien Xmas
tt11332750.description: When extraterrestrials attempt to steal Earth's gravity, only the gift-giving spirit of Christmas -- and a small Alien named X -- can save the world.

tt13997358.name: Fate/Grand Order the Movie: Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot 2 Paladin; Agateram
tt13997358.description: The second part in a two-part anime film project adapting the "Sixth Singularity - Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot" story from the game.

tt13404868.name: The House of the Lost on the Cape
tt13404868.description: A strange old woman allows a teenage runaway and a young orphan to stay in an abandoned house that overlooks the sea. However, when a menacing entity threatens their new home, they must band together and face their fears to save it.

tt0053275.name: Magic Boy
tt0053275.description: Magically gifted boy Sasuke lives in peace, deep in the forest with his animal pals and Oyu, his elder sister. After their forest sanctuary is violated by a demon witch who devours one of Sasuke's animal companions, he vows vengeance. Leaving the forest, he sets out to master his magical gifts, making a pilgrimage to the home of the wizard Hakuunsai. While Sasuke learns the ways of magic, the demon witch terrorizes the countryside, and Sasuke works to complete his training in time.

tt6435164.name: My Love Affair with Marriage
tt6435164.description: A young spirited woman, Zelma, is determined to conform to the pressures of singing Mythology Sirens in order to be loved, but the more she conforms, the more her body resists. A story of inner female rebellion.

tt2704454.name: Little Witch Academia
tt2704454.description: Inspired by a magician named Shiny Chariot, the lively Akko Kagari enters the Little Witch Academy with the dream of one day becoming as cool and great as her idol.

tt13424422.name: Sword Art Online: Progressive - Aria of a Starless Night
tt13424422.description: High school student Asuna struggles to survive with a young swordsman after its revealed that she is trapped inside the game of Sword Art Online, where if your HP drops to zero, your brain will be destroyed in real life.

tt13454122.name: Arlo the Alligator Boy
tt13454122.description: A young humanoid alligator travels to the big city in hopes of reuniting with his estranged father, meeting a colorful cast of characters along the way.

tt1047474.name: Hellboy Animated: Iron Shoes
tt1047474.description: In Ireland in 1961, Hellboy enters a ruined tower and is attacked by Iron Shoes.

tt9784708.name: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Movie
tt9784708.description: When a mysterious stranger arrives from the future with a dire warning, Leo is forced to rise and lead his brothers, Raph, Donnie, and Mikey in a fight to save the world from a terrifying alien species.

tt13680598.name: Puparia
tt13680598.description: Something is about to change drastically, and the only thing to do is to witness it.

tt2330312.name: Bratz: Fashion Pixiez
tt2330312.description: When a new girl transfers into school and their classmate Cymbeline starts acting strange,  Cloe, Jade, Sasha, and Yasmin discover the secret magical world of pixies.

tt13544716.name: My Hero Academia: World Heroes' Mission
tt13544716.description: When a cult of terrorists ruins a city by releasing a toxin that causes people's abilities to spiral out of control, Japan's greatest heroes spread around the world in an attempt to track down the mastermind and put him to justice.

tt12015692.name: Sirocco and the Kingdom of Winds
tt12015692.description: Agnès, Juliette and Carmen's neighbour, writes children's storybooks that take place in a fantasy world, The Kingdom of the Winds. The intrepid sisters discover a passageway between their world and this extraordinary universe. Once on the other side, the girls take on the appearance of cats and discover Sirocco, a terrifying character who can control the wind.

tt10473036.name: The Amazing Maurice
tt10473036.description: A streetwise cat and his gang of rats come up with the perfect money making scheme.

tt13575806.name: Back to the Outback
tt13575806.description: Tired of being locked in a reptile house where humans gawk at them like they're monsters, a group of Australia's deadliest creatures plot a daring escape from their zoo to the Outback.

tt9711282.name: Canvas
tt9711282.description: After suffering a loss, a painter finds his inspiration to create again.

tt0035197.name: Pluto Junior
tt0035197.description: While Pluto naps, his son gets into scrapes with various other animals and other hazards. Pluto eventually wakes up and comes to his rescue.

tt1922736.name: Tatsumi
tt1922736.description: A story based on the life and short stories of Yoshihiro Tatsumi, a mangaka known for his gekiga style of alternate Japanese manga.

tt10954718.name: Dog Man
tt10954718.description: After a policeman and his police dog are fused together to turn into Dog Man, he must stop the villainous Petey the Cat from cloning himself and creating an evil kitten, doubling his evil abilities.

tt10298810.name: Lightyear
tt10298810.description: While spending years attempting to return home, marooned Space Ranger Buzz Lightyear encounters an army of ruthless robots commanded by Zurg who are attempting to steal the fuel source of his ship.

tt13651628.name: Belle
tt13651628.description: Teen Suzu embarks on an epic quest to uncover the identity of a mysterious beast in a virtual world.

tt13322484.name: Cops and Robbers
tt13322484.description: Animation and activism unite in this multimedia spoken-word response to police brutality and racial injustice.

tt13622118.name: Cryptozoo
tt13622118.description: Cryptozookeepers try to capture a Baku, a dream-eating hybrid creature of legend, and start wondering if they should display these beasts or keep them hidden and unknown.

tt2560092.name: The Magician's Elephant
tt2560092.description: An orphaned boy is told by a fortune teller that an elephant will help him find his lost sister.

tt11905122.name: Crocus
tt11905122.description: A woman's nightly domestic rituals—from putting her baby to bed to making love—unspool in a playful parade of surreal, straight-from-the-id images.

tt0094326.name: The Wind in the Willows
tt0094326.description: Badger, Rat and Mole are trying to save Toad Hall and its owner, their rich irresponsible airhead playboy friend Toad, from himself, as well as financial ruin, the court and a gang of conspiratorial weasels who have their eye on t...

tt8354218.name: Fireheart
tt8354218.description: Sixteen-year-old Georgia Nolan dreams of being the world's first-ever female firefighter. When a mysterious arsonist starts burning down Broadway, New York's firemen begin vanishing. The Mayor of New York calls Georgia's father Sh...

tt12532368.name: Chickenhare and the Hamster of Darkness
tt12532368.description: Follows a young hero born half chicken and half hare. Eager to fit in and feel loved in spite of his differences, he is obsessed by adventuring in spite of his clumsiness.

tt13387604.name: Checkered Ninja 2
tt13387604.description: Follow Alex and the Checkered Ninja who embark on a frantic hunt for the villain Phillip Eppermint, who has evaded a prison sentence in Thailand.

tt14062858.name: Us Again
tt14062858.description: An elderly couple regain their youth in the rain.

tt11301374.name: Zog and the Flying Doctors
tt11301374.description: Pearl and Gadabout are now a flying doctor trio, caring for creatures including a mermaid, a unicorn and a sneezy lion. However when bad weather forces them to land at the palace, Pearl is locked up by her uncle, the king.

tt1715210.name: Time of Eve
tt1715210.description: In a not too distant future, a young man's outlook on his home android begins to change after tracking the android's behavioral log to a mysterious cafe.

tt0160522.name: Megazone 23 Part II: Please Give Me Your Secret
tt0160522.description: Shogo Yahagi is on the run. But this time he's got his biker gang called 'Trash' on his side and they have chosen to revolt against the authorities, and the police. An invasion from an ...

tt13740078.name: Eiga Doraemon Nobita no Ritoru Sutâ Wôzu 2021
tt13740078.description: During summer vacation Nobita picks up a small rocket containing Papi, a palm-sized alien president escaping rebels on his home planet Pirika.

tt13758684.name: Fortune Favors Lady Nikuko
tt13758684.description: A heartwarming comedy-drama about the bonds shared by an unconventional mother and daughter in a sleepy seaside town.

tt0118123.name: Wat's Pig
tt0118123.description: In a Medieval castle, a marauder tries to kidnap the twin infant sons of the lord. He makes off with only one, whom he drops about a mile away.
