tt0076495.description: Benny, Keld and computer savvy Georg await old Egon Olsen at his release from prison. Egon has a new plan - theft of USD10,000,000 in Copenhagen. It involves the EEC's (before EU) butter mountain.

tt1483386.name: Forever Young
tt1483386.description: Xavi goes down to his family holiday home in Spain where he meets his best friends. As a gang they enter a race to win the magic tree house where Xavi can wish for his Dad to come back after his parents split and his mum re-marrie...

tt0296845.name: Little Secrets
tt0296845.description: A fourteen-year-old aspiring violinist finds herself under an increasing amount of pressure to keep secrets for herself, her family and her newfound best friend.

tt3003470.name: Christmas for a Dollar
tt3003470.description: A family struggling to get by during the Depression expects another presentless Christmas until the father brings home a dollar for them to spend on presents.

tt5180240.name: Elementary
tt5180240.description: Florence is a school teacher devoted to her students. When she encounters young Sacha, a child with problems, she will do everything she can to help him, even to the point of neglecting her own children.

tt1971466.name: Leafie, A Hen into the Wild
tt1971466.description: Leafie is a hen who manages to escape the horrible conditions of an egg production line. After surviving a harrowing encounter with a one-eyed weasel and being rejected by the barnyard animals where she grew up, a chance encounter...

tt0107444.name: Lotta 2 - Lotta flyttar hemifrån
tt0107444.description: A feisty five-year-old girl Lotta decides to move away from home. And no, she doesn't want to put on the stupid sweater.

tt0271172.name: Jumping Ship
tt0271172.description: Michael has big plans to show his cousin Tommy a good time aboard a luxury yacht--until he discovers that the one he chartered is actually an old rusted fishing boat. But they are forced to jump ship when modern-day pirates chase ...

tt0488870.name: Always: Sunset on Third Street
tt0488870.description: Teenage Mutsuko comes to Tokyo for work but ends up at a repair shop. She befriends the owner's family. Neighbors Hiromi, writer Chagawa with admirer Junnosuke strive alongside them in postwar Tokyo's evolution.

tt0828065.name: Moondance Alexander
tt0828065.description: Moondance (Kay Panabaker) is faced with her father's passing and her overprotective mother (Lori Loughlin). When she finds a lost horse and discovers his abilities, she convinces his owner (Don Johnson) to train them to compete.

tt3845822.name: De Boskampi's
tt3845822.description: Rik Boskamp is dreaming of a different life where he's not constantly bullied in and one in which his father is not a total loser.

tt2371399.name: Moomins on the Riviera
tt2371399.description: The Moomins set sail for the Riviera, where, after a journey fraught with storms and desert island dangers, Snorkmaiden is dazzled by the attentions of a playboy and Moomin learns that jealousy's sting is the most painful of all.

tt2827708.name: Steak (R)evolution
tt2827708.description: Gourmet road trip looking for the best steak in the world. Breeders, farmers, butchers, cooks, historians and business men all around the world (France, Italy, Spain, Sweden, Belgium, UK,USA, Canada, Japan, Argentina, Brazil) help...

tt2907922.name: Christmas with Tucker
tt2907922.description: A young boy learns to be a man after the death of his father and forms a special bond with a dog.

tt0078026.name: The Olsen Gang Goes to War
tt0078026.description: There are top secret plans of turning Denmark into EEC/EU's "holiday park". The Olsen gang plans to steal and sell the plans at DEM10,000,000. After being double-crossed, will patriotism win?

tt2397521.name: Moon Man
tt2397521.description: The gentle man on the moon is lonely and wants to dance and have fun with the people of Earth, but when he comes to Earth on a comet, he's mistaken for an invader and must find his way back home. Based on the beloved children's book.

tt1828224.name: The Legend of La Llorona
tt1828224.description: A group of kids must stop a ghost who abduct kids after the drowning of her own children.

tt4970552.name: Louis & Luca - The Big Cheese Race
tt4970552.description: A secret bet between Solan and Olvar O. Kleppvold, he loses the house and workshop of the genious inventor Reodor Felgen, and they both bring their allies in the fight to win.

tt0082843.name: Olsen-bandens flugt - over plankeværket
tt0082843.description: Money's needed for Kjeld's silver wedding and Egon Olsen has an ingenious plan - steal a red bag with DKK5000000 from the crooked VP of Denmark's largest insurance company. Will Egon survive it?

tt0826711.name: Flight of the Red Balloon
tt0826711.description: A little boy and his baby-sitter inhabit the same imaginary world: through their adventures they are followed by a strange red balloon.

tt0429177.name: The Thing About My Folks
tt0429177.description: Ben's dad Sam shows up one night with a note from Ben's mother (Sam's wife of 46 years), that she has left. While Ben's wife and his three sisters try to find her, Ben takes Sam on a day trip to see a farmhouse that's for sale. The day trip turns into a road trip while dad and son explore their past, their relationship, and why Sam's wife might have left him. The road trip includes fishing, drinking, playing pool, sleeping under the stars, and frank discussion. Anger simmers close at hand, as do love and hope. Where Sam's wife is - and why she left - leads to the movie's resolution.

tt2564706.name: Television
tt2564706.description: As a leader of the local community, Chairman Amin bans every kind of image in his water-locked village in rural Bangladesh. He even goes on to claim that imagination is also sinful since it gives one the license to infiltrate into...

tt0306741.name: Doraemon: Nobita and the Winged Braves
tt0306741.description: Doraemon, Nobita and friends help the humanoid birds of Birdopia to stop Seagrid from awakening Phoenicia a Dragon like Monster Which can bring an End to Both Birdopia and Human World.

tt1260351.name: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's New Great Adventure into the Underworld
tt1260351.description: When Nobita turned the world into a world with magic with the what-if-telephone-booth-gadget, He and his world needed to defeat the threat that became reality in this world.

tt1147508.name: Doraemon: Nobita's Dorabian Nights
tt1147508.description: Nobita and his friends go to rescue Shizuka into the world of the "Arabian Nights (Thousand and One Nights)".

tt0332639.name: He ni zai yi qi
tt0332639.description: A violin prodigy and his father travel to Beijing, where the father seeks the means to his son's success while the son struggles to accept the path laid before him.

tt1147510.name: Doraemon: Nobita and the Spiral City
tt1147510.description: When Doraemon and Nobita win a tiny planet through a lottery, they make use of a screw to bring several toys to life and create a toy town.

tt0074697.name: It's Arbor Day, Charlie Brown
tt0074697.description: Charlie Brown's team is forced to play against Peppermint Patty's in their field that has been converted into a lush garden.

tt0304072.name: The Dog of Flanders
tt0304072.description: Nello Tarth is a poor but happy orphan who lives with his grandfather Jehan and his dog Patrasche in a little village near Antwerp. He spends his days drawing and delivering milk. When Nello decides to enter an art contest, he experiences firsthand the ignorance and cruelty of the villagers of the town. Nonetheless, with the help of his beloved dog, Nello perseveres to achieve his dream.

tt2177180.name: A Year in Burgundy
tt2177180.description: The film follows seven wine-making families in the Burgundy region of France through the course of a full year, and delves into the cultural and creative process of making wine, as well as its deep ties to the land. What lies with...

tt4136636.name: Little Mountain Boy
tt4136636.description: A boy must brave deep winter snow to obtain an important family keepsake. Before he can even start this difficult journey he must first help his family survive financial ruin, rescue his beloved pet goat, and with his best friend,...

tt0174200.name: She's a Good Skate, Charlie Brown
tt0174200.description: Peppermint Patty is in zealous training for a figure skating competition, but with no help from her grumpy coach, Snoopy. He growls coaching tips that don't make sense, and Marcie can't sew the dress Peppermint Patty is dying to wear. Still determined to win, Peppermint Patty turns to Woodstock when disaster looms at the competition.

tt0286476.name: Autumn Spring
tt0286476.description: A bittersweet comedy starring the great Vlastimil Brodský as Fanda, an old man who refuses to grow up. Despite pleas from his exasperated wife who wants him to make serious decisions about the future, Fanda ignores the nagging and spends his days seeking amusement and adventure.

tt0500166.name: VeggieTales: Madame Blueberry
tt0500166.description: Even though Madame Blueberry lives in a nice treehouse, and has lots of friends, she is still upset because she always thinks she needs more "stuff". When a new Stuff-Mart superstore opens ...

tt1147522.name: Doraemon: Nobita and the Galaxy Super-express
tt1147522.description: Nobita and his friends come to the largest amusement park in the universe by the space ship that is modeled on a locomotive. Although they play happily, they are attacked suddenly by unknown aliens.

tt0284605.name: VeggieTales: Esther, The Girl Who Became Queen
tt0284605.description: The king needs a new queen, and Esther has been chosen! But she's about to find out that being queen is going to take more courage than she ever imagined! When a small town girl wakes up with the weight of the world on her shoulders and the fate of her people in her hands, can she find the courage to do what's right?

tt0119052.name: The Education of Little Tree
tt0119052.description: Little Tree is an 8-year-old Cherokee boy who loses his parents during The Great Depression and begins living with his Indian grandparents and learning the Cherokee way of life.

tt0091810.name: The Quest
tt0091810.description: A resourceful American orphan living in rural Australia finds himself caught up in the magic of a local Aboriginal myth that might be more real than anyone knows.

tt1147515.name: Doraemon: The Records of Nobita, Spaceblazer
tt1147515.description: A boy gets a power and confronts the mighty enemies for his friends.

tt4184350.name: Doraemon: Nobita and the Haunts of Evil
tt4184350.description: A sense of responsibility will arise in a boy through one's way of life.

tt0330911.name: Elina: As If I Wasn't There
tt0330911.description: In rural Sweden of the early 1950s, little Elina goes to school again after recovering from tuberculosis, the same illness that has killed her father a few years earlier. Elina's family belongs to Finnish-speaking Finns frowned upon by a staunch schoolmistress who starts hounding Elina for questioning her authority. Elina's mother, sister, and a liberal young male teacher all try to mediate the ensuing battle of wills between Elina and Miss Holm. Elina finds consolation in wandering out on the dangerous marshlands to have imaginary conversations with her dead father. Written by Markku Kuoppamäki

tt2825854.name: Labyrinthus
tt2825854.description: Frikke, a 14-year-old boy, discovers a sinister computer game that uses real children from his neighbourhood as players. In a race against time Frikke must find the evil creator of this horrible game.

tt0367960.name: The Legend of Johnny Lingo
tt0367960.description: When a storm washes a canoe bearing an infant boy ashore upon a small South Pacific island, he is at first well-received as a gift from the heavens, even to the point of the tribal chief adopting him as a successor.

tt0069536.name: White Fang
tt0069536.description: The wolf dog, White Fang, aids a reporter, a fur trapper, a nun, a young Eskimo boy and his father of ridding a gold mining town of a sleazy crime lord in 1896 Yukon, Canada.

tt0286162.name: Stolen Summer
tt0286162.description: A Catholic boy tries to convert a terminally ill Jewish boy, so he will be able to go to Heaven.

tt0382095.name: In Oranje
tt0382095.description: An 11 year old talented soccerplayer, Remco, has one big dream: to be selected for the national team under 12 years. His father Erik coaches him and everything seems to work out fine, until Erik suddenly dies. Remco and mother Syl...

tt0484500.name: My Scene Goes Hollywood: The Movie
tt0484500.description: Barbie and her friends stumble onto a movie set and get cast as extras. But their friendship is tested when one of the girls makes a quick rise to stardom.

tt3438252.name: Apur Panchali
tt3438252.description: This is a real life story inspired by Subir Banerjee,the little child actor who played the iconic role of Apu in Pather Panchali.

tt0441897.name: San Pietro
tt0441897.description: Saint Peter, a reluctant but passionate leader, from the crucifixion of Jesus to his own. The film's first half dramatizes the New Testament's "Acts": early fear, the renewal of Pentecost, Saul's conversion, the decision to baptiz...

tt0075971.name: The Easter Bunny Is Comin' to Town
tt0075971.description: The Mailman decides to stop another deluge of letters by answering questions about the Easter Bunny: Sunny, a baby rabbit found and adopted by Kidville (a town of only kids--even a kid mailman). And when Sunny goes delivering eggs...

tt0070894.name: In Desert and Wilderness
tt0070894.description: Fourteen year old Polish boy Stas Tarkowski and eight year old Nel Rawlison from England are kidnapped as the hostages by Arabic fanatics and taken to their religion leader. Then they manage to escape and try to return to their fathers. Children have a lot of dangerous adventures, meet two Black kids; Kali and Mea, who also help them, make a friendship with an elephant and help one Black's tribe.

tt0284606.name: VeggieTales: God Wants Me to Forgive Them!?!
tt0284606.description: Two great stories on forgiveness! "The Grapes of Wrath" features Junior Asparagus as the hapless target of teasing from a bunch of cranky grapes! Junior learns that forgiveness is the best ...

tt0114623.name: The Purse Snatcher
tt0114623.description: Alex is very close to his elderly grandmother partly because his busy parents seem to have little or no time for him. One day he surprises two boys from his school leaving her house and is shocked to find her tied up inside – they have robbed her! Alex is sworn to secrecy as his gran is worried that her daughter will think her incompetent. This secret leads Alex into trouble as the two boys accost him in the street and bully him into becoming a pickpocket ("tasjesdief") for them, mugging old ladies. Alex learns how to deal with this situation in the end.

tt0227684.name: The Third Prince
tt0227684.description: Once upon a time there was a prince, Jaroslav, whose two other brothers had fallen in love with a beautiful yet mysterious princess from a painting. His brothers had gone far away to seek her, however they never came back from the...

tt1853544.name: Die schwarzen Brüder
tt1853544.description: Giorgio's poor parents sell their son to Milan to work as a chimney sweeper. There he joins the «Black Brothers».

tt0116741.name: Kalle Blomkvist - Mästerdetektiven lever farligt
tt0116741.description: The story is about a boy named Kalle Blomkvist who with his friends solves crimes. But also play the battle between the red rose and the white rose with his rival friends. But everything changes when Kalle Blomkvists friend finds ...

tt0346039.name: Close to Leo
tt0346039.description: When 21-year-old Leo, the oldest of four brothers, announces to his rural French family that he's HIV+ family bonds are tested. The family decides that 11-year-old Marcel, the youngest, is too young to understand, and the family a...

tt0467923.name: Gamera the Brave
tt0467923.description: In 1973, Gamera sacrifices his life to rid the world of the Gyaos once and for all. Thirty-three years later, a small boy, whose father witnessed the 1973 event, named Toru finds a mysterious egg. From it, hatches a small Turtle. ...

tt0489554.name: Scary Godmother: The Revenge of Jimmy
tt0489554.description: Halloween is an exciting time of year for Hannah Marie who is joined by her Scary Godmother and all sorts of new friends including kooky monsters, friendly vampires and silly skeletons. It's a journey to the Fright Side she'll never forget as Hannah and her friends must foil her cousin Jimmy's plans to ruin Halloween for everyone!

tt1606636.name: Moomins and the Comet Chase
tt1606636.description: Moomintroll and his friends rush to save everyone in Moomin Valley from a ferocious comet.

tt0042332.name: Cinderella
tt0042332.description: When Cinderella's cruel stepmother prevents her from attending the Royal Ball, she gets some unexpected help from the lovable mice Gus and Jaq and from her Fairy Godmother.

tt0055254.name: One Hundred and One Dalmatians
tt0055254.description: When a litter of Dalmatian puppies are abducted by the minions of Cruella De Vil, the owners must find them before she uses them for a diabolical fashion statement.

tt0054188.name: Please Don't Eat the Daisies
tt0054188.description: Drama professor turned theater critic balances his home life and career when he moves to the country with his wife and their four sons.

tt0044685.name: Hans Christian Andersen
tt0044685.description: The opening scene of the movie describes it best: "Once upon a time there lived in Denmark a great storyteller named Hans Christian Andersen. This is not the story of his life, but a fairy tale about the great spinner of fairy tal...

tt0024264.name: Little Women
tt0024264.description: A chronicle of the lives of sisters growing up in 19th-century New England. Four sisters fight to keep their family together and find love while their father is off fighting in the Civil War.

tt0035262.name: Road to Morocco
tt0035262.description: Jeff and Turkey, two wild and crazy guys adrift on a raft in the Mediterranean, are cast away on a desert shore and hop a convenient camel to an Arabian Nights city where Turkey soon finds himself sold as a slave...to luscious Princess Shalmar of Karameesh. Naturally, Jeff would like to rescue Turkey from this "dire" fate, even if it means taking his place! But they haven't figured on virile desert chieftain Mullay Kassim, who has designs on the princess himself...

tt0036098.name: Lassie Come Home
tt0036098.description: After her destitute family is forced to sell her, a collie named Lassie escapes from her new owner and begins the long trek from Scotland to her Yorkshire home.

tt0103305.name: Yes Virginia, There Is a Santa Claus
tt0103305.description: While newspaper writer Church struggles with the death of his wife, he receives a "special" assignment. He must answer a little girl's question about whether Santa Claus really exists.

tt0061715.name: The Gnome-Mobile
tt0061715.description: In the Redwood Forests of California, a multi-millionaire lumberman and his two young grandchildren encounter two gnomes who are supposedly the last of their kind.

tt0028988.name: Heidi
tt0028988.description: A plucky little orphan girl gets dumped abruptly into her gruff, hermit grandfather's care, then later gets retaken and delivered as a companion for an injured girl.

tt0063386.name: The Olsen Gang
tt0063386.description: Egon Olsen's criminal trio always gets into unlucky, comical situations when executing Egon's genius plans. After release from prison, he already has a new plan: steal a valuable German item from a secured museum in Copenhagen.

tt0033388.name: The Big Store
tt0033388.description: A detective is hired to protect the life of a singer who has recently inherited a department store, from the store's crooked manager.

tt0045464.name: The 5,000 Fingers of Dr. T.
tt0045464.description: A young boy dreams that he is in an imaginary world where, assisted by his family's plumber, he must save other piano-playing kids like himself from the dungeons of his dictatorial piano teacher who also mind-controls his mother.

tt0019412.name: Speedy
tt0019412.description: Harold "Speedy" Swift, a fan of Babe Ruth and the New York Yankees, saves from extinction the city's last horse-drawn trolley, operated by his girlfriend's grandfather.

tt0029942.name: Boys Town
tt0029942.description: When a death row prisoner tells him he wouldn't have led a life of crime if only he had had one friend as a child, Father Edward Flanagan decides to start a home for young boys.

tt0152073.name: The Princess with the Golden Star
tt0152073.description: A Czech fairy tale about a princess named Lada who runs away from home in a mouse-fur disguise in order to escape an unwanted, forced marriage.

tt0027893.name: Little Lord Fauntleroy
tt0027893.description: An American boy turns out to be the long-lost heir of a British fortune. He is sent to live with the cold and unsentimental lord who oversees the trust.

tt0034461.name: Aniki Bóbó
tt0034461.description: The story takes place in the old streets of Porto and by the banks of the Douro River. A gang of very young kids has just accepted a new member, Carlitos, a shy boy who has "played it tough" by stealing a doll in a shop. Carlitos ...

tt0064755.name: The Olsen Gang in a Fix
tt0064755.description: His friends are there when Olsen is released from prison. He's resocialized. The trio work at a toy factory, then cleaning at Denmark's central bank. When a US gang robs the bank, the trio must clear their names.

tt0016029.name: The Little Colonel
tt0016029.description: In the post-Civil war south, a darling little girl attempts to restore the peace between her parents and her plantation owner grandfather.

tt0046004.name: Little Fugitive
tt0046004.description: A young boy fears that he shot his older brother, who is only faking. He then runs away to Coney Island, a crowded beach area, and gets money by returning soda bottles for their deposits.

tt0039566.name: Life with Father
tt0039566.description: In late nineteenth century New York a Wall Street broker likes to think his house runs his way, but finds himself constantly bemused at how much of what happens is down to his wife. His children are also stretching their wings, discovering girls and making money out of patent medicine selling. When it comes to light he has never been baptized and everyone starts insisting he must do so, it all starts to get a bit too much.

tt0044386.name: Robinson Crusoe
tt0044386.description: The classic story of Robinson Crusoe, a man who is dragged to a desert island after a shipwreck.

tt0062974.name: Finian's Rainbow
tt0062974.description: An Irish immigrant and his daughter move into a town in the American South with a magical piece of gold that will change people's lives, including a struggling farmer and African American citizens threatened by a bigoted politician.

tt0060747.name: Neulovimye mstiteli
tt0060747.description: Teenagers take revenge on cruel chieftains during the civil war. Soviet blockbuster in the best traditions of the western

tt0041259.name: A Connecticut Yankee in King Arthur's Court
tt0041259.description: A singing mechanic from 1912 finds himself in Arthurian Britain.

tt0054853.name: The Errand Boy
tt0054853.description: A goofy paperhanger is hired to root out a financial inefficiency on a Hollywood studio lot, wreaking havoc as he goes.

tt0024914.name: Bright Eyes
tt0024914.description: An orphaned girl is taken in by a snobbish family at the insistence of their rich, crotchety uncle, even as her devoted aviator godfather fights for custody.

tt0254782.name: The Snow Queen
tt0254782.description: An adaptation of Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tale "The Snow Queen".

tt0044518.name: White Mane
tt0044518.description: In the Camargue, France, a young boy bonds with a white haired horse that escaped from ranchers.

tt0027421.name: Captain January
tt0027421.description: A little girl named Star lives with the lighthouse keeper who rescued her when her parents drowned. A truant officer decides she should go to boarding school, but she's rescued by relatives.

tt0056844.name: When the Cat Comes
tt0056844.description: People arrive in a small village with a strange cat wearing glasses. When someone takes them off, he can color people, according to their nature and mood. Adults consider him dangerous; children love him.

tt0060089.name: Alice in Wonderland
tt0060089.description: A girl named Alice falls down a rabbit-hole and wanders into the strange Wonderland.

tt0018054.name: The King of Kings
tt0018054.description: The King of Kings is the Greatest Story Ever Told as only Cecil B. DeMille could tell it. In 1927, working with one of the biggest budgets in Hollywood history, DeMille spun the life and Passion of Christ into a silent-era blockbuster. Featuring text drawn directly from the Bible, a cast of thousands, and the great showman’s singular cinematic bag of tricks, The King of Kings is at once spectacular and deeply reverent—part Gospel, part Technicolor epic.

tt0024854.name: Baby, Take a Bow
tt0024854.description: Eddie Ellison is an ex-con who spent time in Sing-Sing prison. Kay marries him as soon as he serves his time. Five years later, Eddie and his ex-convict buddy Larry, have both gone straight, and Eddie and Kay have a beautiful litt...

tt0027623.name: Flash Gordon
tt0027623.description: Flash Gordon, Dale Arden and Dr. Alexis Zarkov visit the planet Mongo to thwart the evil schemes of Emperor Ming the Merciless, who has set his planet on a collision course with Earth.

tt0033169.name: Tom Brown's School Days
tt0033169.description: Thomas Arnold is hired to be the new headmaster at Rugby, whose students have acquired a reputation for being wild, disruptive, and dishonest. He institutes strict disciplinary policies, and expels numerous boys as a result. Many of the teachers, trustees, and parents turn against him. Squire Brown, his most vocal supporter, decides to send his own son Tom to Rugby as a demonstration of confidence. Tom soon learns that the school is plagued by bullies, and he is frequently targeted by them. He and the other boys are hindered, though, by an unwritten understanding that none of them will ever report the misdeeds of another to the authorities.

tt0038097.name: Son of Lassie
tt0038097.description: Laddie (Son of Lassie !) and his master are trapped in Norway during WW2 - has he inherited his mothers famous courage ?

tt4429160.name: Red Shoes and the Seven Dwarfs
tt4429160.description: Princes who have been turned into Dwarfs seek the red shoes of a lady in order to break the spell, although it will not be easy. A parody with a twist.

tt6811018.name: The Kid Who Would Be King
tt6811018.description: Alex, a 12-year-old boy, and his friends fight an evil sorceress with the help of Excalibur, the sword of King Arthur, in a bid to save the world from her atrocities.

tt8022928.name: Descendants 3
tt8022928.description: Her life in turmoil Audrey has nothing left to loose, she steals the crown and Maleficent's scepter becoming an evil witch, casting a sleeping spell throughout the land. Mal, Evie, Jay, Carlos, Celia, and former foes team up to de...

tt10515852.name: Steven Universe: The Movie
tt10515852.description: Steven thinks his time defending the Earth is over, but when a new threat comes to Beach City, Steven faces his biggest challenge yet.

tt7158430.name: Hearts Beat Loud
tt7158430.description: A father and daughter form an unlikely songwriting duo in the summer before she leaves for college.

tt4844148.name: Mia and the White Lion
tt4844148.description: Mia moves to South Africa with her family to manage a lion farm and develops a special bond with Charlie, a white lion cub; however, things change when she uncovers her father's secret.

tt7365604.name: Dog Days
tt7365604.description: A group of interconnected people in Los Angeles are brought together by their lovely canine counterparts.

tt8969332.name: The Biggest Little Farm
tt8969332.description: Documentarian John Chester and his wife Molly work to develop a sustainable farm on 200 acres outside of Los Angeles.

tt7225386.name: 25 km/h
tt7225386.description: Two very different brothers reunite and start on a very special journey: a road trip on their motorbikes which they imagined in their childhood.

tt5378092.name: The Stolen Princess
tt5378092.description: A story from the age of valiant knights, beautiful princesses, and evil sorcerers. Ruslan, an artist who dreams of becoming a knight, meets and falls in love with the beautiful Mila, without realizing that she is the King's daughter.

tt8223844.name: Modest Heroes
tt8223844.description: An anthology of three original shorts written and directed by Hiromasa Yonebayashi, Yoshiyuki Momose and Akihiko Yamashita.

tt10477558.name: Violet Evergarden: Eternity and the Auto Memory Doll
tt10477558.description: Violet Evergarden, a former soldier returned from war, comes to teach at a women's academy and changes a young girl's life.

tt10204940.name: Spread Your Wings
tt10204940.description: Based on the real story of Christian, a specialist on wild goose migrations, and the adventure he and his son embarked.

tt8328740.name: Okko's Inn
tt8328740.description: After losing her parents in a car accident, Okko starts living in the countryside with her grandmother who runs a traditional Japanese inn. While she prepares to be the next owner of the inn, Okko can somehow see friendly ghosts.

tt2850480.name: The Girl Who Invented Kissing
tt2850480.description: When a nameless drifter girl steps off the bus, she enters into the lives of two lonely brothers. In spite of her immediate attraction to the younger brother TOMMY, she befriends the older brother VICTOR - a lovable lummox who is often the butt of the joke at the local watering hole. Victor is hard of hearing and mentally soft on account of a car accident in their childhood. The mysterious girl courts danger and adventure but brings fresh life and love into the world of these paralyzed, resigned characters and upsets the delicate balance of their lies - to each other and to themselves.

tt8010354.name: The Tiger Who Came to Tea
tt8010354.description: A young girl befriends a tiger and invites him over for tea.

tt9020536.name: Ejen Ali: The Movie
tt9020536.description: After being accidentally recruited as a spy, 12-year-old Ejen Ali has now grown to embrace his role in secret agency Meta Advance Tactical Agency (MATA) to protect the futuristic city of Cyberaya from outside threats.

tt0053137.description: After a global nuclear war, the residents of Australia must come to terms with the fact that all life will be destroyed in a matter of months.

tt0054594.name: The Absent Minded Professor
tt0054594.description: A college professor invents an anti-gravity substance which a corrupt businessman wants for himself.

tt0049169.name: Earth vs. the Flying Saucers
tt0049169.description: Extraterrestrials traveling in high-tech flying saucers contact a scientist as part of a plan to enslave the inhabitants of Earth.

tt0058544.name: Ghidorah, the Three-Headed Monster
tt0058544.description: A detective protects a princess who prophecies Earth's destruction by a powerful space monster; the world's only hope being if Mothra can persuade Godzilla and Rodan to unite and save the planet.

tt0031951.name: Son of Frankenstein
tt0031951.description: Returning to the ancestral castle long after the death of the monster, the son of Dr. Frankenstein meets a mad shepherd who is hiding the comatose creature. To clear the family name, he revives the creature and tries to rehabilita...

tt0049646.name: The Quatermass Xperiment
tt0049646.description: Professor Bernard Quatermass' manned rocket ship returns to Earth, but two of the astronauts are missing and the survivor seems ill and unable to communicate.

tt0054790.name: The Day the Earth Caught Fire
tt0054790.description: When the U.S. and Russia unwittingly test atomic bombs at the same time, it alters the nutation (axis of rotation) of the Earth.

tt0082701.name: Malevil
tt0082701.description: A group of ordinary French survived a nuclear war and found themselves in the face of what was left of civilization.

tt0055894.name: The Day of the Triffids
tt0055894.description: After an unusual meteor shower leaves most of the human population blind, a merchant navy officer must find a way to conquer tall, aggressive plants which are feeding on people and animals.

tt0053363.name: The Tingler
tt0053363.description: An obsessed pathologist discovers and captures a parasitic creature that grows when fear grips its host.

tt0065566.name: The Computer Wore Tennis Shoes
tt0065566.description: At Medfield College, an accident with a donated computer gives Dexter Riley the ability to remember any knowledge learned instantly and perfectly.

tt0059346.name: Invasion of Astro-Monster
tt0059346.description: Astronauts encounter the Xiliens, who ask Earth's people to help save them from "Monster Zero", but when one of the astronaut romances a mysterious woman, he uncovers the Xilien's true intentions.

tt0045917.name: Invaders from Mars
tt0045917.description: A young boy learns that space aliens are taking over the minds of earthlings.

tt0050873.name: Quatermass 2
tt0050873.description: Professor Quatermass, trying to gather support for his Lunar colonisation project, is intrigued by mysterious traces that have been showing up.

tt0045546.name: The Beast from 20,000 Fathoms
tt0045546.description: A ferocious dinosaur awakened by an Arctic atomic test terrorizes the North Atlantic and, ultimately, New York City.

tt0049782.name: Rodan
tt0049782.description: A mining engineer investigates the deaths of his colleagues, discovering prehistoric nymphs and a creature capable of flying - and wreaking havoc - at supersonic speeds.

tt0034786.name: The Ghost of Frankenstein
tt0034786.description: Dr. Frankenstein's plans to replace the brain of his monster are hijacked by his scheming and malevolent assistant Ygor.

tt0057518.name: Son of Flubber
tt0057518.description: When Professor Brainard experiments further on Flubber derivatives, he gets in trouble and only his students can help.

tt0061683.name: Frankenstein Created Woman
tt0061683.description: After being reanimated, Baron Frankenstein transfers the soul of an executed young man into the body of his lover, prompting her to kill the men who wronged them.

tt0065738.name: Frankenstein Must Be Destroyed
tt0065738.description: Baron Frankenstein, with the aid of a young doctor and his fiancée, kidnaps the mentally sick Dr. Brandt in order to perform the first brain transplant operation.

tt0062794.name: Charly
tt0062794.description: An intellectually disabled man undergoes an experiment that gives him the intelligence of a genius.

tt0060548.name: Island of Terror
tt0060548.description: An isolated remote island community is threatened by an attack by tentacled silicates which liquefy and digest bone and tissue.

tt0050720.name: The Monolith Monsters
tt0050720.description: Rocks from a meteor which grow when in contact with water threaten a sleepy Southwestern desert community.

tt0049967.name: X the Unknown
tt0049967.description: A radioactive, mud-like creature terrorizes a Scottish village.

tt0122111.name: Voyage to the End of the Universe
tt0122111.description: The year is 2163. Starship Ikarie XB 1 embarks on a long journey across the universe to search for life on the planets of Alpha Centauri.

tt0060440.name: The War of the Gargantuas
tt0060440.description: A giant, cannibalistic humanoid's rampage through Tokyo is halted by his more docile twin, but neither their reunion nor their scientist caretakers can prevent their eventual duel.

tt0027800.name: The Invisible Ray
tt0027800.description: Dr. Janos Rukh discovers a certain type of radium that has almost magical healing properties. But the element has a dangerous side, too, and it has already started affecting Rukh. Consumed by paranoia, he begins to suspect that his wife is having an affair. Wild for revenge, Rukh hatches a deadly plot...using his own poisoned body as a weapon to kill.

tt5397194.name: Anon
tt5397194.description: In a world without anonymity or crime, a detective meets a woman who threatens their security.

tt2331047.name: Rememory
tt2331047.description: A man steals a machine that can extract, record, and play a person's memories to try to solve the murder of the scientist who invented it.

tt3839880.name: Infinity Chamber
tt3839880.description: A man trapped in an automated prison must outsmart a computer in order to escape.

tt7543784.name: All the Gods in the Sky
tt7543784.description: 30-year-old factory worker Simon lives a solitary existence on a decrepit farm in the remote French countryside. Devoting his time to caring for his sister Estelle, who was left severely disabled when a childhood game went horribl...

tt10395866.name: Executive Order
tt10395866.description: In a dystopian near future in Brazil, an authoritarian government orders all citizens of African descent to move to Africa - creating chaos, protests, and an underground resistance movement that inspires the nation.

tt2850834.name: Living Still Life
tt2850834.description: In a world in decay, a woman collects her dead animals and restores them to life by filming them  images by image.

tt7078926.name: Firebase
tt7078926.description: Set during the Vietnam war, Firebase follows American soldier Hines through an ever-deepening web of science fiction madness.

tt6599818.name: Team Thor: Part 2
tt6599818.description: Thor enjoys some time away from battle.

tt11540272.name: Lapsis
tt11540272.description: Struggling to support himself and his ailing younger brother, delivery man Ray takes a strange job in a strange new realm of the gig economy.

tt9320184.name: Blind Willow, Sleeping Woman
tt9320184.description: A lost cat, a giant talkative frog and a tsunami help a bank employee without ambition, his frustrated wife and a schizophrenic accountant to save Tokyo from an earthquake and find a meaning to their lives.

tt0098373.name: Spirits of the Air: Gremlins of the Clouds
tt0098373.description: Brother and sister endure alone together in a post-apocalyptic Outback until the sudden arrival of a stranger.

tt7026488.name: Come True
tt7026488.description: A teenage runaway takes part in a sleep study that becomes a nightmarish descent into the depths of her mind and a frightening examination of the power of dreams.

tt6341832.name: Oxygen
tt6341832.description: A woman wakes in a cryogenic chamber with no recollection of how she got there. As she's running out of oxygen, she must rebuild her memory to find a way out of her nightmare.

tt9735470.name: Little Fish
tt9735470.description: A couple fights to hold their relationship together as a memory loss virus spreads and threatens to erase the history of their love and courtship.

tt0206752.name: The Flash III: Deadly Nightshade
tt0206752.description: The Scarlet Speedster teams up with the city's previous superhero, The Nightshade, in two adventures.

tt12298506.name: Black Box
tt12298506.description: After losing his wife and his memory in a car accident, a single father undergoes an agonizing experimental treatment that causes him to question who he really is.

tt0088269.name: I Love Maria
tt0088269.description: A gang of criminals terrorizes Hong Kong with two killer robots, one of which is modelled on the gang's female thug, Maria. When the robot gets damaged during a mission, an inventor working for the police captures and reprograms her to develop an independent personality.

tt0097007.name: The Caller
tt0097007.description: One night, an unusual stranger in need asks a woman living alone in a house in the woods if he can use her phone. It soon becomes clear that they're playing a strange mind game and that there's something very wrong about the woods.

tt11341742.name: In Search of Tomorrow
tt11341742.description: A nostalgic journey through '80s sci-fi films, exploring their impact and relevance today, told by the artists who made them and by those who were inspired to turn their visions into reality.

tt0365467.name: Making 'The Matrix'
tt0365467.description: A promotional making-of documentary for the film Matrix, The (1999) that devotes its time to explaining the digital and practical effects contained in the film. This is very interesting, seeing as how they're giving away the cinem...

tt12474056.name: New Order
tt12474056.description: A lavish high-society wedding unexpectedly turns into a class struggle that leads to a violent coup.

tt4679820.name: Lifted
tt4679820.description: A little girl and her inventor father celebrate the success of their greatest dream, on a day she will never forget.

tt0292492.name: Doctor Who: Shada
tt0292492.description: Shada: a prison built by the Time Lords for defeated would-be conquerors of the universe. A scientist named Skagra needs the help of one of the prison's inmates. He finds nobody knows where Shada is anymore, except one aged Time Lord who has retired to Earth, where he is a professor at St Cedd's College. Luckily for the universe, Skagra's attempt to force the information out of Professor Chronotis coincides with a visit by the professor's old friend, The Doctor.

tt10380900.name: Petrov's Flu
tt10380900.description: A day in the life of a comic book artist and his family in post-Soviet Russia. While suffering from the flu, Petrov is carried by his friend Igor on a long walk, drifting in and out of fantasy and reality.

tt6963278.name: Sense8: Creating the World
tt6963278.description: Go behind the scenes and around the world with the "Sense8" cast and crew in this in-depth look at how the hit series is made.

tt7550000.name: Project Power
tt7550000.description: When a pill that gives its users unpredictable superpowers for five minutes hits the streets of New Orleans, a teenage dealer and a local cop must team with an ex-soldier to take down the group responsible for its creation.

tt0092007.name: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
tt0092007.description: To save Earth from an alien probe, Admiral James T. Kirk and his fugitive crew go back in time to San Francisco in 1986 to retrieve the only beings who can communicate with it: humpback whales.

tt0106452.name: Body Snatchers
tt0106452.description: A teenage girl and her father discover alien clones are replacing humans on a remote U.S. military base in Alabama.

tt0054387.name: The Time Machine
tt0054387.description: A turn-of-the-century inventor's vision for a utopian society is disillusioned when travelling forward in time reveals a dark and dangerous fate for humanity.

tt0046534.name: The War of the Worlds
tt0046534.description: A small town in California is attacked by Martians, beginning a worldwide invasion.

tt0086837.name: 2010: The Year We Make Contact
tt0086837.description: A joint USA-Soviet expedition is sent to Jupiter to learn exactly what happened to the "Discovery" and its H.A.L. 9000 computer.

tt0072730.name: A Boy and His Dog
tt0072730.description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a boy who can communicate with his dog telepathically is targeted by a mysterious committee.

tt0212712.description: Several women enter a science fiction author's life over the course of a few years, after the author has lost the woman he considers his one true love.

tt0100403.name: Predator 2
tt0100403.description: Los Angeles police hunt an alien creature in 1997.

tt0102975.name: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
tt0102975.description: On the eve of retirement, Kirk and McCoy are charged with assassinating the Klingon High Chancellor and imprisoned. The Enterprise crew must help them escape to thwart a conspiracy aimed at sabotaging the last best hope for peace.

tt0069280.name: Slaughterhouse-Five
tt0069280.description: Billy Pilgrim has mysteriously become unstuck in time. He goes on an uncontrollable trip back and forth from his birth in New York to life on a distant planet and back again to the horrors of the 1945 fire-bombing of Dresden.

tt0048918.description: In a totalitarian future society, Winston Smith, whose daily work is re-writing history, tries to rebel by falling in love.

tt0072856.name: Death Race 2000
tt0072856.description: In a dystopian future, a cross country automobile race requires contestants to run down innocent pedestrians to gain points that are tallied based on each kill's brutality.

tt0088170.name: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
tt0088170.description: Admiral Kirk and his bridge crew risk their careers stealing the decommissioned U.S.S. Enterprise to return to the restricted Genesis Planet to recover Spock's body.

tt0064519.name: Journey to the Far Side of the Sun
tt0064519.description: The European Space Exploration Council sends two astronauts to explore a planet similar to the Earth but located on the opposite side of the sun.

tt0093207.name: Royal Space Force: The Wings of Honneamise
tt0093207.description: A young astronaut participates in a controversial fledgling space program.

tt1483797.name: Redline
tt1483797.description: A story about the most popular racing event in the galaxy, the Redline, and the various racers who compete in it.

tt0058379.name: Mothra vs. Godzilla
tt0058379.description: When greedy tycoons refuse to return Mothra's egg, the people of Infant Island must decide if they are willing to answer Japan's own pleas for help when Godzilla arises near Nagoya.

tt0088979.name: D.A.R.Y.L.
tt0088979.description: A seemingly normal young boy is found abandoned on a mountain road and adopted by a family who are increasingly amazed by his abilities before discovering the secret behind his real identity.

tt0065462.name: Beneath the Planet of the Apes
tt0065462.description: The sole survivor of an interplanetary rescue mission searches for the only survivor of the previous expedition. He discovers a planet ruled by apes and an underground city run by telepathic humans.

tt31254554.name: Wonderland
tt31254554.description: In 'Wonderland', people can use an A.I. program to communicate with virtual versions of their comatose or lost loved ones.

tt0206341.name: Thumb Wars: The Phantom Cuticle
tt0206341.description: In a sendoff of the original Star Wars, several fingers and thumbs are used to act out the roles of would-be heroes and villians as the forces of finger and thumb clash of an evil super-weapon.

tt0077658.name: Hardware Wars
tt0077658.description: A short film parody of the classic science fiction film Star Wars. It premiered in theaters only seven months after Star Wars and consisted of little more than inside jokes and visual puns that heavily depended upon audience familiarity with the original.

tt0997147.name: Big Man Japan
tt0997147.description: An eccentric man living alone in a decrepit house in Tokyo periodically transforms into a 100-foot tall giant in order to defend Japan against similarly sized monsters.

tt7267706.name: Seam
tt7267706.description: When Yusef discovers his beloved wife Ayana is a Sleeper, a living android bomb left over from a past war, he has only one choice: flee with her to the border of the Machine homeland in the desert, and pray they can make it before time runs out.

tt0351167.name: The Cathedral
tt0351167.description: A space fantasy about an explorer who pays a visit to an unusual cathedral built with organic materials.

tt10267266.name: A.E.S.O.P.
tt10267266.description: An award winning Indie festival favorite, AESOP is a film about a company that has developed a pill that ends the aging process, meaning people will not age or die of old age. Unfortunately, not everyone will get it. Ruth works at AESOP, helping decide who gets the pill and who doesn't. She meets and falls in love with Marie, and eventually learns that Marie will not be eligible for the pill.

tt0466043.name: Khottabych
tt0466043.description: Gena is a hacker by heart and soul. He's a good fella. But he got himself in some real troubles. And the only thing that can save him - is a thousand years old Djinni, who attempts to learn how to live in the modern world.

tt0044876.name: The Man in the White Suit
tt0044876.description: An altruistic chemist invents a fabric which resists wear and stain as a boon to humanity, but big business and labor realize it must be suppressed for economic reasons.

tt0384116.name: G.O.R.A.
tt0384116.description: A slick young Turk kidnapped by extraterrestrials shows his great « humanitarian spirit » by outwitting the evil commander-in-chief of the planet of G.O.R.A.

tt7560984.name: Cognition
tt7560984.description: Journeying through the symbolic landscape of the subconscious mind, the story follows an unbreakable bond between father and son. A bond that transcends space and time.

tt20201212.name: Alienoid: The Return to the Future
tt20201212.description: Pursuit of a divine sword drives Taoist time travelers, aliens, and bounty hunters across eras. Lee Ahn races to rescue trapped allies while an alien Controller unleashes Haava, leaving present day Earth in ruin.

tt0244290.name: Virtual Nightmare
tt0244290.description: Advertising executive Dale Hunter (Michael Muheny) works at the agency Arora. But after a car accident, his life changed abruptly. He has nightmares at night and by day he suffers from hallucinations. The world looks like from a computer. Numbers and names adhere to the objects. A doctor can not help him and the hallucinations are getting worse. Librarian Wendy seems to be the only person he can trust. Together they try to find out the truth.

tt9161434.name: The Hug
tt9161434.description: An animatronic panda at a rundown pizza place seems to be out of order… until little Aden gives it a hug.

tt1808482.name: Solaris
tt1808482.description: Kris Kelvin joins the space station orbiting the planet Solaris, only to find its two crew members plagued by "phantoms," creations of Solaris. Kelvin is soon confronted with his own phantom, taking the shape of his dead wife Hari.

tt0069738.name: The Asphyx
tt0069738.description: English country squire Sir Hugo Cunningham searches for immortality by literally 'bottling up' the Spirit of the Dead, or Asphyx.

tt13207508.name: Swan Song
tt13207508.description: In the near future, a terminally ill man explores a heart wrenching, emotionally complex solution to save his wife and son from grief by duplicating himself without them knowing.

tt13483866.name: Linoleum
tt13483866.description: When the host of a failing children's science show endeavors to achieve his childhood dream of becoming an astronaut by constructing a rocket ship in his garage, a series of bizarre events occur that cause him to question his own ...

tt10960102.name: E noi come stronzi rimanemmo a guardare
tt10960102.description: Arturo is an up-and-coming manager who, without suspecting it, introduces the algorithm that will make him superfluous in his company. He loses his girlfriend, his job and his friends all at once. In order not to remain homeless t...

tt13650540.name: If You Were the Last
tt13650540.description: Adrift in their broken-down space shuttle with little hope of rescue, two astronauts argue over whether they're better off spending their remaining days as friends or something more.

tt13472984.name: Two Distant Strangers
tt13472984.description: A man trying to get home to his dog gets stuck in a time loop that forces him to relive a deadly run-in with a cop.

tt0094371.name: Mirror for a Hero
tt0094371.description: Two casual acquaintances, Sergey Pshenichnyy and Andrey Nemchinov, are transferred almost 40 years ago by the will of mysterious circumstances. This day - May 8, 1949 - begins to repeat itself for them with inexorable constancy.

tt0804529.name: Sleep Dealer
tt0804529.description: The near future. Like tomorrow. In a world marked by closed borders, corporate warriors, and a global computer network, three strangers risk their lives to connect, break through the barriers of technology, and unseal their fates.

tt14122288.name: I'm Totally Fine
tt14122288.description: Vanessa, a woman in mourning, takes a solo trip to clear her head after the death of her friend, but her self-care vacation plans change when she's met with an out-of-this-world situation.

tt2736758.name: Doctor Who: The Great Detective
tt2736758.description: Vastra, Jenny, and Strax try to persuade the grumpy Doctor to engage again.

tt14500584.name: Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes
tt14500584.description: A cafe owner discovers that the TV in his cafe suddenly shows images from the future, but only two minutes into the future.

tt14371426.name: Flashback
tt14371426.description: A female lawyer travels back in time and crosses paths with other women in history who fought for women's rights.

tt1704292.name: Battlestar Galactica: Blood & Chrome
tt1704292.description: The adventures of young William Adama in the First Cylon War.

tt14578676.name: Star Wars Biomes
tt14578676.description: Take a virtual vacation to some of the Star Wars films' most iconic and beloved locations like Hoth, Tatooine, and Sorgan, as this charming series whisks you off for fly-through tours of the Galaxy Far, Far Away.

tt14145426.name: Beavis and Butt-Head Do the Universe
tt14145426.description: After a "creative" judge sentences them to space camp, a black hole sends our adolescent heroes 24 years into the modern future where the duo misuse iPhones, embark on a quest to score, and become targets of the Deep State.

tt11009596.name: The Land of the Sons
tt11009596.description: The end of civilization has arrived. A Father and his Son are among the survivors. When the Father dies, the Son decides to undertake a journey along a river, in search of someone who can read his journal.

tt13841874.name: The Sacred Spirit
tt13841874.description: When the leader of a UFO association dies unexpectedly, José Manuel becomes the only person who knows a secret that could alter the fate of humanity. Meanwhile, a young girl goes missing in Spain.

tt11264262.name: Unfamiliar Cosmos
tt11264262.description: An art-house exploration of the grand, awe inspiring, unsettling implications of an infinite universe.

tt1982759.name: Le Sequel
tt1982759.description: After the disaster of Le Fear, director Carlos Revalos decides to make a sequel with a bigger budget. What could go wrong? Simply everything.

tt15471560.name: Smoking Causes Coughing
tt15471560.description: A group of vigilantes called the Tobacco Force is falling apart. To rebuild team spirit, their leader suggests that they meet for a week-long retreat, where they bond over scary stories before returning to save the world.

tt21440560.name: Viking
tt21440560.description: A behavioral research team observes and attempts to replicate the experiences of the first manned mission to Mars.

tt13270424.name: Brian and Charles
tt13270424.description: After a particularly harsh winter Brian goes into a deep depression; completely isolated and with no one to talk to, Brian does what any sane person would do when faced with such a melancholic situation. He builds a robot.

tt14407336.name: The Beast
tt14407336.description: In the near future artificial intelligence is in control of everyone's lives and human emotions are perceived as a threat.

tt11366674.name: Lola
tt11366674.description: 1940, Thom and Mars have built a machine, LOLA, that can intercept radio and TV broadcasts from the future. Unknown to them sharing these broadcasts the devastating changes it will have on the future of world but to them also.

tt19719904.name: Plan 75
tt19719904.description: Faced with a rapidly aging population, a Japanese government in the near future rolls out an unsettling agenda.

tt16478146.name: We Are Not Alone
tt16478146.description: SF comedy set after Earth has been invaded by a race of aliens, the Gu'un. A hapless human called Stewart is appointed the Gu'un's official liaison, is saddled with an alien housemate and must deliver their message to the masses.

tt20225374.name: Vesper
tt20225374.description: Struggling to survive with her father after the collapse of Earth's ecosystem, 13-year-old Vesper must use her wits, strength and bio-hacking abilities to fight for the future.

tt13986278.name: The Ordinaries
tt13986278.description: Paula, a young supporting character, studies at the Main Character School and dreams on graduating to become a lead.

tt20859464.name: The Artifice Girl
tt20859464.description: A team of special agents discovers a revolutionary new computer program to bait and trap online predators. After teaming up with the program's troubled developer, they soon find that the AI is rapidly advancing beyond its original...

tt0832446.name: The Lost Spider Pit Sequence
tt0832446.description: What the "spider-pit" sequence from the original King Kong (1933) probably looked like (the original sequence was cut out of the original movie because it was deemed "too gruesome" and was subsequently lost).

tt21426456.name: Molli and Max in the Future
tt21426456.description: A man and a woman find their orbits repeatedly colliding over the course of 12 years, four planets, three dimensions and one space cult.

tt32263401.name: Reflection in a Dead Diamond
tt32263401.description: A retired spy suspects his former adversaries have resurfaced when his intriguing neighbor vanishes.

tt1028528.name: Death Proof
tt1028528.description: Two separate sets of voluptuous women are stalked at different times by a scarred stuntman who uses his "death proof" cars to execute his murderous plans.

tt3766354.name: The Equalizer 2
tt3766354.description: Robert McCall serves an unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed, but how far will he go when that is someone he loves?

tt10208198.name: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
tt10208198.description: A crime boss teams up with a cop to track down a serial killer.

tt1409024.name: Men in Black 3
tt1409024.description: Agent J travels in time to M.I.B.'s early days in 1969 to stop an alien from assassinating his friend Agent K and changing history.

tt0102798.name: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves
tt0102798.description: Robin Hood decides to fight back as an outlaw when faced with the tyranny of the Sheriff of Nottingham.

tt4630562.name: The Fate of the Furious
tt4630562.description: When a mysterious woman seduces Dominic Toretto into the world of terrorism and a betrayal of those closest to him, the crew face trials that will test them as never before.

tt20916568.name: The Wrath of Becky
tt20916568.description: Two years after escaping a violent attack, a teenage girl must defend herself against a domestic terrorist cell.

tt0120347.name: Tomorrow Never Dies
tt0120347.description: James Bond is sent to disrupt a media mogul's plot to foment a war between China and the United Kingdom.

tt6806448.name: Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
tt6806448.description: Lawman Luke Hobbs and outcast Deckard Shaw form an unlikely alliance when a cyber-genetically enhanced villain threatens the future of humanity.

tt3811906.name: Malignant
tt3811906.description: Madison is paralyzed by shocking visions of grisly murders, and her torment worsens as she discovers that these waking dreams are in fact terrifying realities.

tt1535108.name: Elysium
tt1535108.description: In the year 2154, the very wealthy live on a man-made space station while the rest of the population resides on a ruined Earth. A man takes on a mission that could bring equality to the polarized worlds.

tt7991608.name: Red Notice
tt7991608.description: An Interpol agent successfully tracks down the world's most wanted art thief with help from a rival thief. But nothing is as it seems as a series of double-crosses ensues.

tt7737786.name: Greenland
tt7737786.description: To save his family from a catastrophic end of times, a man embarks on a risky quest to locate the last hope for salvation and witness the worst of mankind in the battle for survival.

tt1013752.name: Fast & Furious
tt1013752.description: Brian O'Conner, back working for the FBI in Los Angeles, teams up with Dominic Toretto to bring down a heroin importer by infiltrating his operation.

tt0144117.name: The Boondock Saints
tt0144117.description: Two Irish Catholic brothers become vigilantes in order to try to wipe out Boston's criminal underworld in the name of God.

tt6146586.name: John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum
tt6146586.description: John Wick is on the run after killing a member of the international assassins' guild, and with a $14 million price tag on his head, he is the target of hit men and women everywhere.

tt0103855.name: The Bodyguard
tt0103855.description: A former Secret Service agent takes on the job of bodyguard to an R&B singer, whose lifestyle is most unlike a President's.

tt2872732.name: Lucy
tt2872732.description: A woman who has become accidentally trapped in a dark deal with a mysterious and brutal criminal overlord transforms into a merciless warrior evolved beyond previously known human evolutionary limits and turns the tables on her ca...

tt0317740.name: The Italian Job
tt0317740.description: After being betrayed and left for dead in Italy, Charlie Croker and his team plan an elaborate gold heist against their former ally.

tt2788710.name: The Interview
tt2788710.description: Dave Skylark and his producer Aaron Rapaport run the celebrity tabloid show "Skylark Tonight". When they land an interview with a surprise fan, North Korean dictator Jong-Un Kim, they are recruited by the CIA to assassinate him.

tt0112851.name: Desperado

tt5095030.name: Ant-Man and the Wasp

tt0080253.name: The Best of Not the Nine O'Clock News Volume One
tt0080253.description: Attention, comedy fans: NOT THE NINE O'CLOCK NEWS is the real thing. This is scathing, no-holds-barred Brit humor at its best. Rapid-fire skits starring Rowan Atkinson (Mr. Bean) are as politically incorrect as they are side-bustingly funny, sparing no one as they take on the British Royal Family, Margaret Thatcher, Scotland Yard, country music, Christianity, devil worship, punk rock and bathroom etiquette. NOT THE NINE O'CLOCK NEWS is so irreverent that when the pilot was due to air in April 1979, the BBC cancelled it due to its incendiary political content. When at last it aired, the greatest comedy group to hit England since Monty Python's Flying Circus stormed the airwaves and revolutionized British and American television alike. Discover the show that set the standard for the anarchic cynicism that defined the alternative comedy of the 80's.

The circumstances of his untimely death have never been completely resolved - until now. Unfortunately, the editor's daughter Nina accidentally takes the tape with her to Munich, where she is about to visit her paralyzed Mom in a sanatorium. When this information reaches the CIA and the BND, both organizations compete to get hold of the tape. Meanwhile Erkan & Stefan, two loveable wannabe supercheckers from Munich, are assigned as bodyguards for Nina - of course, they are expected to mess up their job, so that the tape can be retrieved. But the two friends prove to be a bit more streetwise than CIA or BND ever expected.

tt0293092.description: After Dexter is confronted with robots who wish to "destroy the one who saved the future," he uses his time machine to see how he saved it. They declare that they are here to destroy the one who saved the future, and make ready to attack Dexter. Dexter easily destroys them with the use of various tools and gadgets from his lab. However, news that he is "The One Who Saved the Future" intrigues him, and he decides to travel through time to discover how cool he is. In the first time period he visits, Dexter finds a tall, skinny, weak version of himself working in office-designing cubicles, with Mandark as his rich, successful boss. The child Dexter unwittingly reveals the existence of blueprints regarding the "Neurotomic Protocore", and Mandark steals it after the two Dexters move forward in time.

tt0124315.name: The Cider House Rules

In the end, the gorgeous Solange finds her own, highly problematic tonic to her troubles in the form of a 13-year-old boy.

Her name is Tatiana, she's passing through, and pitches her tent in Sasha's yard. The two women build an odd rapport, and tension builds as events unfold.
